Now a convert, Robin is missing that all-important 'Christmassy' feeling, so the gang members share their secrets to getting into the festive spirit - but when even more decorations and merry music don't do the trick, the ghosts wonder if Robin will be able to capture that Christmas magic again

programme.title: Impossible Peace

programme.title: Grand Tours of the Scottish Islands
programme.desc: Paul Murton explores the Isle of Mull and its satellite islands to discover why they have become boltholes from the hustle and bustle of the modern world. He begins on the tidal island of Erraid, which inspired famous Scottish writer Robert Louis Stevenson, then hops over to Ulva, the final resting place of Lachlan MacQuarrie, one of the first governors of New South Wales. He then explores Mull itself, being given a whistlestop tour of the island by rally driver Louise Thomas, then travels to the mysterious little island of Inch Kenneth, where he hears the story of Nazi sympathizer Unity Mitford. He ends his tour at the remote Treshnish Islands, where he experiences a spot of 'puffin therapy'

programme.title: Grand Tours of the Scottish Islands
programme.desc: Paul Murton visits Gigha and Jura, two islands of the Inner Hebrides that are only a few miles apart but could not be more different. He begins at the Achamore Gardens on Gigha, which were created in the 1930s by the malted-drink millionaire James Horlick. He loved Gigha's mild climate so much that he bought the island and made it his home. Today Gigha is owned by the community, and many of its residents are incomers attracted by the opportunity to begin a new island life on this small and fertile place. Where Gigha is small, lush and verdant, Jura is rugged and awe-inspiring. Despite being one of Scotland's largest islands, just 200 people live there - alongside more than 5,000 deer

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: Action spy thriller starring Tom Cruise. The world has been plunged into chaos by the machinations of all-powerful sentient AI "the Entity", which has sown misinformation and distrust among nations and citizens. Only rogue US agent Ethan Hunt has the means to stop the Entity and avert armageddon - but can he and his team stay one step ahead?

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Action spy thriller based on the 1960s TV series, starring Tom Cruise, Jon Voight and Emmanuelle Béart. The elite Impossible Mission Force's latest assignment is to recover stolen information that threatens to blow the cover of US spies throughout the world. But the plan goes disastrously wrong.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Nicholas Hoult and Ewan McGregor. Humanity is put on the menu when a farm boy opens the gateway between our world and a fearsome giant race.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from Monster Family to The Amazing Maurice.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter. As the annual Giant Vegetable Competition approaches, enterprising Wallace and Gromit cash in with their humane pest-control outfit, "Anti-Pesto". But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure based on the popular TV series. Tommy Pickles is feeling forced out by his new baby brother who just makes too much noise. But when Tommy hatches a plan to return his sibling to the hospital, it leads to some unexpected adventures.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bruce Willis and Chrissie Hynde. Young Tommy Pickles gets the opportunity to meet his nature-documentary hero Sir Nigel Thornberry, after his family vacation goes awry. Stranded on a desert island, the baby and his pals think they're alone, until they encounter the Thornberry clan filming their latest animal epic.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, Chris Rock and David Schwimmer. A zebra called Marty tries to escape his comfortable existence at the Central Park Zoo and return to the wild. Accompanying him, albeit reluctantly, are Alex the lion, a neurotic giraffe and a no-nonsense hippo.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, David Schwimmer and Chris Rock. The escaped animals from Central Park Zoo - Alex the Lion, Melman the Giraffe, Marty the Zebra and Gloria the Hippo - try to fly back from Madagascar but are forced down in the wilds of Africa, where they soon encounter some familiar faces.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Musical adapted from the popular stage show, starring Albert Finney and Carol Burnett. In Depression-era America, ten-year-old orphan Annie shuts out her unhappy life with dreams of "tomorrow". Then her luck changes when she is temporarily adopted by billionaire Daddy Warbucks.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Fantasy horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell and Embeth Davidtz. The second sequel to the original Evil Dead finds Ash back in medieval times and desperate to return to the present. But to do so, it means having to take up arms against an army of familiar old foes.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Generations
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and featuring William Shatner. When an evil alien threatens to destroy a star system along with millions of lives, Captain Jean-Luc Picard travels into a time vortex to enlist the help of his famous predecessor, James T Kirk.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Patrick Stewart. During a Federation encounter with the Borg, a sphere escapes into the Earth's past via a temporal vortex. Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise take up the challenge to pursue the Federation's most fearsome enemy and stop them from changing the future.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and Jonathan Frakes. The planet Ba'ku holds magical properties that keep the population young and living in harmony. So when an alien race attempts to take over this paradise, it falls to Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet and its people.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and featuring Sharon Stone. After suffering a series of nightmares about Mars, construction worker Douglas Quaid discovers that the planet may in fact hold the key to his true identity.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. Arthur Curry (aka Aquaman), the half-human heir to the throne of Atlantis, has long since rejected his underwater brethren. But when his half-brother and current king Orm plots to destroy the surface world, Arthur is drawn into a quest to unite the marine realms and save humanity.

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Morgan Freeman and Aaron Eckhart. A disgraced former bodyguard to the President of the United States gets the chance to redeem himself when he becomes trapped inside the White House following a terrorist attack.

But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.desc: The 4077th seek out a dog that bit Radar to save him the agonies of a painful course of rabies injections, and Hawkeye defies Frank to treat a soldier suffering hysterical paralysis. Korean War comedy, starring Alan Alda

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Radar rescues a lamb destined for the spit at a Greek-style feast, conning Henry into giving it a medical discharge and passage back to America, but the celebrations go ahead without the main ingredient when Trapper and Hawkeye come up with a new recipe using tinned meat

programme.title: Gone in 60 Seconds
programme.desc: Action crime drama starring Nicolas Cage as former car thief Randall "Memphis" Raines, who agrees to come out of retirement for one more job in return for the life of his younger brother, who has fallen foul of a ruthless crime boss. But is the task of stealing 50 top-of-the-range vehicles in four days beyond even Randall's prodigious talents?

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Sick of eating liver and fish for the 11th straight day, Hawkeye hatches a plan to order 40 pounds of spare ribs from his favourite restaurant. Korean War comedy, starring Alan Alda

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Thriller starring Ben Affleck and Charlize Theron. When ex-con Rudy Duncan impersonates a former cellmate who has apparently been killed in prison, it leads him into a dangerous game involving the dead man's beautiful pen friend and her ruthless brother.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime drama starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Andy Garcia and Robert De Niro. Determined young federal agent Eliot Ness leads a tough team of investigators in a dangerous mission to end Al Capone's violent reign of terror in Prohibition-era Chicago.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Al Pacino, John Cazale and Charles Durning. On a hot August day in 1972, Sonny Wortzik and two accomplices enter a Brooklyn bank and hold the staff at gunpoint. But the robbery goes wrong and when police surround the building, Sonny and his morose friend Sal become trapped inside with their hostages.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: Comedy drama, based on the true story of conman Frank Abagnale Jr, starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks. Shattered by the news that his parents are divorcing, 16-year-old Frank runs away to New York. For six years he lives a life of fraud, cashing over $2 million in bad cheques while impersonating an airline pilot, a paediatrician and a lawyer, and always staying one step ahead of tenacious FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Samuel L Jackson. Businessman Ken Carter is recruited to improve the fortunes of a failing high-school basketball team. His exacting standards soon put the players under extreme pressure - both on the court and in the classroom.

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online and fall in love after the end of human civilisation. Award-winning drama written and directed by Sam Zuchero and Andrew Zuchero, starring Steven Yeun and Kristen Stewart

programme.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy directed by Francis Coppola and starring Kathleen Turner and Nicolas Cage. While attending the 25th anniversary reunion of her old high-school class, Peggy Sue Bodell faints and wakes up in 1960. Faced with living her time over again, will she still marry the man she's about to divorce in the present day?

programme.title: The Cinema List: Black History Month
programme.desc: Celebrate Black history through the power of cinema with unforgettable performances and stories, from Dreamgirls to Sinners and the stars who brought them to life

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Samuel L Jackson. Businessman Ken Carter is recruited to improve the fortunes of a failing high-school basketball team. His exacting standards soon put the players under extreme pressure - both on the court and in the classroom.

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: Comedy drama, based on the true story of conman Frank Abagnale Jr, starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks. Shattered by the news that his parents are divorcing, 16-year-old Frank runs away to New York. For six years he lives a life of fraud, cashing over $2 million in bad cheques while impersonating an airline pilot, a paediatrician and a lawyer, and always staying one step ahead of tenacious FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

programme.title: The History of Sound
programme.desc: In 1917 New England, unassuming music student Lionel Worthing meets David White in a bar. There is an instant connection between men with a mutual interest in the history of folk music, and they spark a passionate affair, conducted behind closed doors. Historical drama, starring Paul Mescal, Josh O'Connor and Chris Cooper

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn and Chase Infiniti. Years after the collapse of his political revolutionary group, Bob Ferguson lives in paranoid seclusion with his teenage daughter, Willa. But the merciless Colonel Lockjaw, a one-time target of Bob's group, has been hunting its members ever since, and has unfinished business with Bob.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Shout at the Devil
programme.desc: A drunken American and an Old Etonian Englishman involved in poaching in Zanzibar find their illicit activities disrupted by the area's German colonial commissioner. The outbreak of the First World War gives them the perfect excuse to get even by destroying a German battleship docked in the area for repairs. Action adventure, starring Lee Marvin, Roger Moore, Ian Holm and Jean Kent

programme.title: Instrument of War
programme.desc: When US B-24 bomber pilot Clair Cline is captured in northern Germany, he and his fellow PoWs must find a way to survive their captivity during the Second World War. Drama, starring Jack Ashton and Elliot James Langridge

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The second visit of the week is to Ingliston Country Club in Renfrewshire, where events manager Shauna Kirk and sales manager Fiona Gallagher prove a force to be reckoned with. Guests Steve and Allard aren't feeling the dated décor, and John proves that one size doesn't fit all. Ronnie and Steph are blown away by the competition, but they think that perfection comes at a price

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Steve and Allard welcome their rivals to 1692 Wasdale in the Lake District. Fiona and Shauna think it's picture perfect, but other guests face tricky technology and cleanliness concerns.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Confident John welcomes his rivals to the Lynbar Hotel. He says his breakfast's the best in Blackpool, but will his guests agree?

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The B&B owners meet for the last time, to find out how much they've been paid, to settle some scores, and to find out who's won

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: A collector with an unusual taste for high-voltage oddities reveals his shocking stash. And Mike and Frank's luck runs cold when they're stonewalled by two brothers.

programme.title: The Dog House Australia
programme.desc: Nala's waited 160 days for the right human to come along... Is widower Lino her knight in shining armour? And the Starkey family meet a potentially massive Mastiff.

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Documentary set inside Woodgreen animal charity, following efforts to match dogs with new owners. Nine-year-old Rohan meets Patterdale terrier puppy Friday, but there are concerns that the hound may be just a bit too enthusiastic for the youngster. Rocco the Jack Russell has been struggling to find a home, though his bouncy exuberance and love of a good face lick means he could be the perfect match for Zach, who is looking for a dog not fazed by his Tourette's. Grant the stray westie has seen some tough times, but his luck might be about to change with the arrival of Casper and Sid

programme.title: The Secret Life of the Zoo
programme.desc: The fly-on-the-cage-wall documentary returns, with more stories about the animals of Chester Zoo. The keepers suspect Margery the Malayan tapir may be eating for two, while James Bond the macaw is put into quarantine to ensure he does not have the same disease that killed his partner, Miss Moneypenny. The tiny but mighty golden mantella frog family is in need of a breeding boost, with hopes resting on minuscule male Eddie, who needs to summon up all his stamina to successfully court his frog princess Fergie

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: French comic crime drama about a former police negotiator who abruptly returns to his role when he and his eldest daughter are held hostage during a bank robbery. Their captor is an angry family man demanding that his debts be cancelled or he'll blow himself and everyone else up. In French

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: Antoine, Manon and the rest of the hostages are now in even more danger, because of press interference. Antoine tries to calm Fabien and regain his trust. In French

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Single father Gary, 47, is put in a medically induced coma at King's College Hospital to reduce the risk of brain damage following a serious motorcycle accident, and 69-year-old Steve confronts his fear of needles when a nurse has to remove a fishbone stuck in his finger. Meanwhile, 58-year-old lung cancer patient Terry is in A&E with his carer Sandy, a year after being given two weeks to live

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
Love Monster has agreed to teach Bad Idea Puppy how to DJ for the In a Spin Day opening ceremony. He starts by trying to teach him the beginning of his In a Spin Day song. The song is composed by pressing a series of buttons in a particular order, which Love Monster slowly demonstrates. But when it's Bad Idea Puppy's turn, he forgets the order and hits other random buttons, causing the song to go super-fast or super-loud. Not how Love Monster wants it to be.
Love Monster realises that teaching is a lot harder than he thought it would be and worries because his song needs to be just right for everyone to be able to skate to the beat. As he demonstrates the song again, Bad Idea Puppy distractedly jumps around to the beat, which gives Love Monster an idea. Love Monster reproduces the buttons on his decks but makes them much larger, like on a dance mat. Maybe Bad Idea Puppy will be able to learn though his dancing? But when Bad Idea Puppy tries to remember the sequence, he gets excited and randomly hops and rolls over the buttons.
Love Monster continues to try and teach Bad Idea Puppy to learn his song, but he just can't get it right and keeps getting distracted. Love Monster is worried that his song won't be perfect, but Bad Idea Puppy thinks he sounds great! At the opening ceremony, Bad Idea Puppy starts the song but accidentally cuts off the music. An alarmed Love Monster quickly restarts the sequence for Bad Idea Puppy, but rather than let him try again, Love Monster ends up taking over and pressing the buttons for him. But it's too late and the beat is off. Bad Idea Puppy is oblivious and just dances along anyway.
Elder Kitten boogies over and chuckles that this reminds him of when Love Monster was learning to DJ in his back garden when he was little. Love Monster remembers that he learned to DJ by making mistakes and trying again until he got it just right. He lets Bad Idea Puppy take control of the decks again. Bad Idea Puppy starts out by making lots of mistakes, but gradually the noises start to align with the beat, and it starts to sound okay. Love Monster realises that trying is more important than getting it perfect. Bad Idea Puppy invites him to join him, and they DJ together as the Fluffytowners skate to the beat.

The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc:
The Twirlywoos are in a hall where they watch a couple rehearsing a ballroom dance, accompanied by a piano player. He starts off playing slowly and speeds up towards the end of the dance, which gets quicker and more energetic. The Twirlywoos watch this with interest, and when the pianist steps out to take a break, they decide to investigate the piano.
They start to play their own tune by running and jumping on the keys, and the dancers come in and start trying to dance to it. As the Twirlywoos get carried away, the tune gets faster and faster, and the dancers try frantically to keep up. The Hooter ends the performance by calling the Twirlywoos home, and the dancers fall in an exhausted heap on the floor!
The Twirlywoos come back to the boat to find the Twirlywoo Screen. A red dot appears, and when Toodloo touches it, it makes a 'splat' sound. More dots appear, and the Twirlywoos splat them as quickly as they can. The dots appear faster and faster, and the Twirlywoos have to move faster to keep up with them. Eventually the whole Twirlywoo Screen is covered in brightly coloured splats, like an abstract painting.

Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Marta, Hud, Theo, Isobel, Sehaj, Isaac and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too!
Inside everyone's bags in this episode are teddy bears which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate teddy bears inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby!
The fun song 'Round and Round the Garden' features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Baby Bear Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

When Indy's baby came early (just like her little sister), it needed special care and attention, requiring her mother Indy to be very brave. But Rusty ruined everything by picking the early baby up! programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc:
After the Squirrels find out that knitting is one of Duggee's favourite things to do, they ask him what it means to have a favourite thing. After Duggee explains that it's something you like more than anything else, the Squirrels wonder what their favourite things are.
To help them decide, they interview a few of their friends to find out what different things and activities are special to them. Some answers are predictable, some are surprising, and some even have more than one favourite thing... wait, you can have more than one favourite thing? Well in that case, why not have a list of top ten favourites! With a fun Top of the Pops-style countdown from ten to one, each Squirrel shows off some of the things that are most important to them. But what will come in at number one?

Chantelle and Rory's fact files help answer all of Harrison's questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, crane flies are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Rory, Sandy and Zoe make their legs grow with the help of some stilts, as they discover what it's like having long legs like a crane fly!

Aneeshwar and Lizzie head into the dark to meet some Senegal bushbabies. These shy creatures are nocturnal and only come out at night. Using special cameras, we see that they have satellite-like ears that constantly move around, trying to pick up the slightest sounds of their favourite food - like bugs.
Next, they meet two dwarf crocodiles. These tiny crocs are doing target training. When they nudge a coloured target, they get fed. Bushbabies and dwarf crocodiles are very different animals, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: AI: Probably Nothing To Worry About
programme.desc: The fullest account yet of AI's origins, told by the people who built it. Exclusive interviews and archival footage put pioneers Geoffrey Hinton and Demis Hassabis on the record, alongside former OpenAI staff. Hinton quit Google, fearing the technology he helped create. A Microsoft chatbot threatens its users. AI systems learn to deceive the people testing them. Not just a tech history lesson but an anarchic thriller, this is the story of a technology whose power sits not in the algorithms, but with the handful of people who control them

programme.title: Unreported World: South Africa's Whistleblower Hitmen

South Africa has a thriving marketplace of hitmen, with killings commissioned through middlemen and carried out for relatively small sums. Once the preserve of gangland turf wars, a hitman's services are now used to settle scores across the country, with 141 targeted killings in 2022 alone

programme.title: A Place in the Sun

programme.title: George Clarke's Building Home

But will torrential rain and an escalating budget stand in the way of Sophie finishing her dream home?

programme.title: Jon Richardson: Old Man Tour

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey builds herself the perfect make-believe playhouse out of the couch cushions and is delighted when Bingo, Mum and Dad all build their own houses next door! Their new neighbourhood is fantastic, until Bingo takes over Bluey's reading nook with her growing menagerie of farm animals! Unsure how to resolve the situation amicably, Bluey reaches out to Mum (who's having issues of her own dealing with a constantly noisy Dad). When Mum demonstrates the power of being firm yet polite with Dad, Bluey is able to find a compromise with Bingo that restores peace to their tiny neighbourhood.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At bedtime, Bingo panics when she can't find her beloved toy, Floppy. With Mums help, they retrace their steps backwards through the game they played that day to help Bingo remember. Starting with the balcony where they cooked a chickenrat egg, then the bathroom where Dad laid the egg in the laundry. Further back is the Living Room where they turned Dad into a chickenrat in the first place! But the trail goes cold as they can't find Floppy anywhere. On the verge of losing hope, Bingo suddenly remembers and races to the balcony to find that her toy was hidden in the chickenrat egg all along.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: During a quick trip to the shops Bluey, Bingo and Dad play a game of 'Kids', where Bluey plays Mum, Bingo is her cute baby, Snowdrop, and Dad is her sulky son, Diddums. Not only does Bluey hamper Dad's efforts to buy groceries, by buying nothing but junk food, but she also prefers the secretly naughty Snowdrop over Dad and even embarrasses him in front of his friends. When Dad rebels and shows how much of a handful he can really be, Bluey puts her foot down and declares that Snowdrop is her favourite child. Diddums is devastated and Bluey finally recognises why Dads don't pick favourites.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad collapse on the couch after a busy day, they give Bluey and Bingo five minutes until bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mt MumandDad! Bluey hurries ahead, too impatient to wait for Bingo as she packs her camping supplies, leading to accusations of cheating. All their bickering wakes the rumbling mountain and an avalanche of pillows and tickles sends them scurrying for shelter in Bingo's tent. Waiting for the storm to pass, Bingo breaks out her supplies and Bluey apologises for cheating. When the storm passes, they make for the summit and plant their flag together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday in the bush, Bluey makes a new friend, a French speaking boy named Jean-Luc. They may not understand the same language, but that doesn't stop them spending their days laughing, playing, planting seeds and hunting for a wild Daddy pig. But one morning, Bluey is heartbroken to discover that Jean-Luc and his family have packed up and gone home. That night Mum tells Bluey that special people come in and out of our lives and she must always cherish the good times. Many years later, a teenage Bluey sits beneath the tree grown from their seeds and sees Jean-Luc once more.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey loves playing hide and seek, but the family are convinced she will get distracted and forget to find them. Bluey promises to stay focused and, after a count to twenty, the game is on! But her promise quickly comes undone when she uncovers Chattermax (a noisy old toy) hidden under the sink. Bluey is distracted and forgets their game, leaving her frustrated family stuck hiding. It's only when she rediscovers how noisy and annoying Chattermax can be, and needs help shutting it off, that Bluey at last harnesses her ability to focus, remembers the abandoned game and finds everyone at last.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Indy and Rusty love playing the Mums and Dads, but they can't agree on who'll stay home to look after the baby. Looking for a new partner to babysit while she works, Indy finds herself faced with Mackenzie's digging obsession, Snickers constant distraction and Winton's gentle befuddlement. Rusty also has it bad, as Bluey pops him in a pram and insists he be her baby! After the rough-and-tumble terriers finally prove to be terrible babysitters too, Indy bumps into a bonnet clad Rusty who's keen to make up (and get away from Mummy Bluey) and they return home to look after the baby together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Calypso mediates as Bluey and friends accuse Rusty of ruining their game. They were playing a simple game of baby hospital. When Indy's baby came early (just like her little sister), it needed special care and attention, requiring her mother Indy to be very brave. But Rusty ruined everything by picking the early baby up! Rusty apologies, explaining that he was playing a game of Knights and he was just trying to rescue the king's daughter, kidnapped by a ravenous dragon. As he explains the bravery of the king's daughter, Bluey and her friends recognise how much their games have in common.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey's having a fun copying everything Dad says and does, including Olympic walking, but the game takes a serious turn when she finds a hurt budgie by the side of the path. Dad and Bluey bundle it into a shoebox and head to the vet. But despite their best efforts, the budgie dies. To deal with her feelings, Bluey enlists Bingo and they re-enact her morning, racing Budgie Bingo to Mum's vet for some emergency help. When Bingo makes a miraculous recovery, Bluey is upset that the game hasn't gone the way she planned, but she takes solace in knowing that some things are just out of her hands.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Princesses, horses and magic wands. Bluey and Chloe can play any role they want, when they embark on an adventure to save their playground kingdom from the Greedy Queen

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: When Sandman causes trouble on a mountain, Team Spidey uses their Rescue-Webs vehicles to stop him. Rocket & Groot help Spidey save a stolen pufferfish from Lizard.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Team Spidey must stop Green Goblin from controlling Zola with a remote. Spidey, Ghost-Spider, and Mr. Fantastic must get a super-powered belt back from Black Cat.

programme.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
programme.desc: Minnie makes special backpacks, inspiring a hike to Goofy Rock. Using Mouseketools, they reach the top where Goofy climbs his namesake rock for a photo.

programme.title: Sofia the First: Royal Magic
programme.desc: Camila wants to be Cedric's apprentice but causes chaos with advanced spells. Sofia is paired up with Zane's sister, Zaria, for a tri-castle activity, but they have nothing in common.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey insists Mum and Dad relive their old backpacking days by strapping Bluey, Bingo, Muffin and Socks to their backs and going on an adventure in the garden. But with these cheeky backpacks getting up to mischief, haggling for street food and minicab rides in this strange foreign land is proving a tricky proposition. At the kids prompting, Dad eats too much and needs a bathroom fast! Guidebook in hand. Mum finds their hostel at last but the passports are lost in the bottom of their bags. They only have one option left - shake their giggling bags upside down until everything falls out!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey gives a tour of the animals at her backyard zoo to Lady Gaberdene (Mum) and her adorable toddler, Snowdrop (Bingo), her visitors are especially taken with the big blue Daddy Gorilla. But when Daddy Gorilla scoops up Snowdrop and makes his escape, Zookeeper Bluey has to give chase, while calming an hysterical Lady Gaberdene. With the help of a carefully laid banana trap, Bluey manages to recapture the wild beast, tickling him back to sleep. Seeing how sad Snowdrop is to say goodbye, Zookeeper Bluey bends the rules and arranges one more night-time meetup between the new best friends.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On a car trip to the dump, Dad convinces Bluey that he knows absolutely everything and is the best dad in the world. And when Bluey challenges him, asking difficult questions, Dad's got all the right answers. But when they get to the dump and Bluey sees Dad throwing away some of her old drawings, she realises he may not be right about everything after all. Dad does his best to apologise, explaining that he's actually not perfect and that he was recycling the paper for other kids to use for their drawings. This makes sense to Bluey who accepts his flaws and forgives him.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad is the king of trampoline games and the girls can't get enough. But when it's time for Dad to go to work, Bluey and Bingo can't bear to see him go. Insisting he can't leave without a proper meal, they make him play the breakfast game - bounce-cooking Bingo and Bluey as toast, eggs and even a disgusting smoothie. But all good things must end, and as an emotional Bluey says goodbye, Dad charges her with a job of her own; making up her own new games. She accepts the challenge and with the help of a garden sprinkler transforms the trampoline into a salad spinner for a delighted Bingo and Mum.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Facing an overnight stay in the hospital, Bingo is upset that she can't go home. But her spirits are lifted when Mum shows her a video on her tablet sent by Dad and Bluey. In a ramshackle film shoot of friends, relatives and neighbours, Bluey spins the tale of a young girl on a quest to help heal her poor sick puppy named Bumpy. Her journey leads her across the lands to a wise old wolfhound (played by Aunt Trixie) who opens her eyes to a simple truth - everyone gets sick sometimes and it's just a part of life. As Bumpy is healed with time and love, everyone takes a bow for a delighted Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Playing a game of 'Work', Dad hires cheeky Bluey and frog Bingo for his drainpipe factory. Bluey soon causes trouble, taking every chance to slack off. But rather than be reprimanded, she promotes herself to be Dad's new boss! Bluey proves a stern taskmaster, having Dad lick the floor and even polish the window with his bottom! When Bingo makes Dad break the 'No Dancing' rule, he is fired. Seeing Dad sitting unhappily outside, the ribbiting Bingo encourages him to dance his troubles away and he impresses Mum's passing ballerina, who finds him a new career as a professional dancer.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Spidey helps Mr. Fantastic when his hiccups cause him to change shapes. After a potion turns them into kittens, Spidey and Spin must get creative to defeat Lizard.

programme.title: Sofia the First: Royal Magic
programme.desc: Sofia and her new flying horse, Wildfyre, try out for the Charmswell Flying Derby. Wanting to be good at potions, Zane accidentally creates out-of-control, Green-Eyed Goo Monsters.

programme.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
programme.desc: Dozens of letters and packages arrive at the Clubhouse by mistake. Mickey and Minnie find out that Von Drake's mail-sorting invention is broken.

programme.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
programme.desc: The pals help Minnie throw a dinner party for Clara Cluck. Using Mouseketools, they set the table, dress up in hats, and finish cooking before guests arrive.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: After Dad ignores Bingo, trouble comes to the Heelers house, which fills up with invisible mischief-making fairies. Tails are braided, Mum gets a peg beard and Dad's phone ends up in fairy dancing circle! Mum suspects someone hurt the fairies' feelings and sends Bingo to see what they want. Bingo leads the family to a message demanding Dad dance a jig around the letterbox in front of the neighbours. Dad refuses, but when the fairies freeze Bingo like a statue, he tells her not to worry - he would do anything for her. His merry jig finally pleases the fairies, unfreezes Bingo and saves the day.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bored of the overcrowded local playground, Dad leads Bluey, Bingo and Mackenzie on an adventure to discover their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey finds the weird bugs and untamed landscape intimidating at first. But as the natural wonder of the bush enchants her, she finds her resilience and inner strength with each passing step. By the time they reach the picturesque watering hole, Bluey is enraptured with the simple natural beauty that surrounds her. And after a well-deserved dip they return to civilization, with Bluey more confident than ever before.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love a good game of 'Grannies', hobbling about on canes and causing mischief. But when Bingo does the floss dance, Bluey insists that it's definitely not something Grannies do. Unable to agree, they video call Nana who gives it her best shot. But she just can't do it. Bluey revels in her victory a little too much, and a sad Bingo quits their game. When Mum tells Bluey, she has to choose between being right or keeping Bingo happy, Bluey finds a third option - teaching Nana how to floss! Under Bluey's instruction, Nana becomes a flossing expert and Bingo is soon back in the game.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey, Bingo and their young friend Missy turn the hammock swing at the playground into a pirate ship, Mum narrates as Dad whips up a wild storm. But it all proves too much for Missy who gets scared and abandons ship. Mum can't persuade Missy to conquer her fears and re-join them, especially when Bluey and Bingo are swallowed by a big blue Daddy whale. But when Missy has an idea to save her friends in the whale's stomach, she digs deep, finds her courage and jumps on board, ready to tickle the beast and free her shipmates. And Dad obliges and spits them all up, ready for more adventures.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When mum goes for a walk by herself along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her, keen to share a shell she has found. Pretending to be a mermaid who has finally got her legs for the day, she embarks on a precious solo adventure, following Mum's footprints along the shoreline. Along the way she encounters a surfer, some pesky seagulls, a cast of crabs, a washed-up jellyfish and a rather large and nervous pelican. Having experienced what it's like to be on your own for the first time, Bluey reunites with Mum and they listen to the shell, before walking back down the beach together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's a rainy day, and Bluey has set up a taxi service inside. Her first fare is a stressed-out businessman (Dad) who needs to get to the airport immediately! Bluey assures him there will be no delays, but then immediately picks up passenger number two, a rich lady (Bingo) and her child, Millicent (Floppy). Between the roundabout directions of the SATNAV (Mum), Millicent vomiting all over him and the taxi finally breaking down, Dad decides to head to the airport on foot. He boards the plane in the nick of time, only to discover that the other passenger is the rich lady and the pilot is Bluey!

programme.desc: At a sleepover at Sofia's castle with Camila and Layla, stuffies magically come to life. A grumpy dragon is on the loose at Charmswell, and Zane tries to tame the bumbling beast.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Zola steals Captain America's motorcycle and races through the city. WEB-Quarters gets shrunk down and lost in the city with Ghosty and Spin inside.

programme.title: SuperKitties
programme.desc: Bitsy says goodbye. SuperKitties save the talent show.

programme.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
programme.desc: Join Mickey, Minnie & their pals for new adventures!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As Dad takes Bluey and Bingo on an early morning wagon ride to the park, Bluey can't wait to get to her beloved monkey bars. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat to his friends. Frustrated, Bluey keeps interrupting the grown-ups' conversations. Dad instructs her to be polite but it's not until she observes Bingo playing happily that Bluey sees she can play her own games along the way too. The next time Dad stops to chat near a bus stop, Bluey creates her own bus game with Bingo, roping Dad in to play. No longer in a big rush, Bluey learns to relax and enjoy the journey.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: A simple game of 'shops' between Bluey and her friends becomes impossible as no one can agree on who's who and what the rules are! Who's in charge of the checkout? What are they paying with? Who gets to be a kitten? Between Bluey's wanting people to wait and the switching around of her friend's roles, they'll never get started! Mackenzie soon gets fed up with the delays and quits, causing Bluey to reach out and apologize, agreeing that they'll start listening and not to be too impatient with each other from now on. United once more, they are finally able to open their imaginary shop's doors.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As Mum packs everyone's things for a trip to the pool without her, Bluey and Dad tease her about being so over-prepared. But when they arrive, they quickly discover that they've forgotten to bring the bag she packed! Bingo doesn't have her floaties, Bluey doesn't have her goggles and there are no towels! Stuck in the ever-shrinking shady bits (as the sunscreen was in the bag too) and with no morning tea to eat, Dad and the kids are about to give up on the day. But when Mum heroically arrives with all the missing stuff, they learn that sometimes you need a little planning to have a lot of fun.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: While having a picnic in the park, Bluey, Bingo and Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets. Big Sister, Little Sister, and Little Fairy walk their fingers on an adventure beyond the Blue Mountains. Big Sister is hesitant to climb up such a steep hill, but Little Sister's enthusiasm is infectious as they reach the top and slide down the other side. There they encounter a cheeky fox who traps Big Sister in his cave. Finally, Little Sister saves the day, and leads them all to safety and the softest beds in the world.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: With a five dollar bill from the tooth fairy, Bluey is thrilled to go to the local markets with Dad to spend her money! But as she explores the market stalls with her friend Indy, committing to a purchase proves harder and harder. With everything from horse rides to poffertjes on offer, the choices are overwhelming! Following a panicked impulse buy, Bluey regrets she won't be able to buy a song from a busker. But Indy's assurance that 'what goes around comes around' rings true as the five dollar bill travels it's way around the market and gives Bluey a second chance.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo fail to win a prize on a Magic Claw machine, Mum tries to cheer them up by creating their own version at home. But when Dad's Magic Claw demands payment, the girls must haphazardly complete some chores for spare change and a chance to play. But Dad's making it too hard and they still can't win! Dad tempts Bluey to try for a shot at winning a 'bottomless bowl of ice-cream', but only if Bingo sacrifices her most beloved toy. Close to victory at last, Dad's Claw malfunctions! Fed up, everyone takes matters into their own hands and tickles Dad until he gives up their prizes.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Team Spidey helps reunite a family of dolphins that are under Doc Ock's mind control. Green Goblin's Garbage Cannon messes up the beach on Earth Day.

programme.title: Sofia the First: Royal Magic
programme.desc: It's Sofia's first day of royal magic school, and she teams up with new friends to win a race and gets a magical visit from Rapunzel.

programme.title: SuperKitties
programme.desc: Bitsy gets cloned. Zsa-Zsa steals the SuperKitty Kit.

programme.title: Pupstruction
programme.desc: The Pups build an island and make a bubble volcano.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Receptionist Bluey welcomes Honey to Dr Bingo's surgery, asking what's wrong. Deciding on a sore knee (despite Bluey suggesting bigger) Honey finds herself stuck in the waiting room as the more exciting cases get priority - from alligators on heads to cuddled cactuses. When Rusty jumps to the front of the line thanks to his uncontrollable baby hippo burps, Honey worries she might never get a turn. programme.desc: Eric Casaburi, a former undercover boss, invites six other employers who also appeared incognito on the show to talk about their experiences of the programme at a restaurant. However, little do they realise that Eric is going to try to fool them by appearing as a waiter. Featuring Kat Cole, Paul Damico, Andy Wiederhorn, Sheldon Yellen, Anthony Wedo and Jane Grote Abell

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: A little girl has a unique approach to making cookies. Plus, nail-biting near-misses and a musical tribute to funny pets

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: In West Covina, Rene brings Gunter for moral support, but gets annoyed when the older German refuses to take sides. Darrell stumbles over what may be a diamond in the rough, while Brandi and Jarrod discover a different national pastime

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The buyers head to Thousand Oaks for the next set of auctions. Justin sinks his money into a unit with an interesting pair, Dave pushes Mary to the breaking point, while Kenny finds the time to make a nice profit piece by piece

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: Tensions run high on the Katina, with questionable leadership and messy personal relationships dominating everyone's attention - and it doesn't help that one member of the crew is causing extra chaos

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to Charlie's Italian bistro in La Verne, southern California, where the owner's lack of business nous is putting her relatives' homes at risk, after her mother and sister put them up as collateral. To make matters worse, the restaurant's food is less than appetising and its long-serving chef seems to be incompetent

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay's next stop is Philadelphia, where family run restaurant Chiarella's is struggling to survive in an area full of thriving Italian eateries. Tommy and Dina Defino's marriage is on the verge of collapse and his sense of personal failure only adds to the troubles of their crisis-ridden business

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy panel show's version of the words-and-numbers quiz, as guest captain Jason Manford and Joe Wilkinson take on guest captain Lee Mack and Fay Ripley. Alex Horne and the Horne Section join Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley takes care of the letters and numbers

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown Christmas Special
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words and numbers quiz, with Jon Richardson and Catherine Tate teaming up against Sean Lock and Joe Wilkinson. Joe Lycett joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, and Rachel Riley is in charge of the numbers

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Daisy May Cooper, Johnny Vegas, Katherine Parkinson, Mawaan Rizwan and Richard Herring take on the penultimate selection of ludicrous challenges. Highlights include Mawaan volleying oranges, Katherine counting plastic balls and Richard spilling blood for the cause. Greg Davies judges their efforts, while Alex Horne keeps score

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programme.desc: Struggling to cope with his alter ego Venom, Eddie Brock attempts to re-ignite his journalistic career by interviewing serial killer Cletus Kasady. However, Kasady becomes the host of the symbiote Carnage and escapes prison after a failed execution. Comic-book fantasy sequel, directed by Andy Serkis and starring Tom Hardy, Woody Harrelson and Michelle Williams

programme.title: For Those in Peril
programme.desc: Drama starring George MacKay. A young man called Aaron is the only survivor of a mysterious fishing accident that claimed the lives of five others, including his older brother. Shunned by the local community, Aaron retreats into himself and begins to believe that he may have the power to bring his brother back.

programme.title: Gunman's Walk
programme.desc: Western starring Van Heflin and Tab Hunter. Growing up in the shadow of former gunslinger Lee Hackett is a tough proposition for his sons Ed and Davy. While Davy looks for love, Ed's explosive temperament threatens to destroy everything his father has built.

programme.title: Arizona Raiders
programme.desc: Western starring Audie Murphy and Michael Dante. Two captured Confederates are promised freedom if they join the Union's Arizona Raiders in a bid to destroy their old guerrilla group.

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Francis and Donna Reed. The new medical officer at a remote fort comes in for criticism when he provides treatment to the local native American tribe.

programme.title: Warlock
programme.desc: Western drama starring Richard Widmark, Henry Fonda and Anthony Quinn. When the townspeople of Warlock decide to take a stand against a group of hellraising cowboys, they find their choice of an ageing marshal brings its own problems.

programme.title: Twister

programme.desc: Former Special Forces operative Roy Pulver wakes every day in his apartment with a beautiful woman in his bed and assassins trying to kill him. Stuck in a time loop, Roy must dodge bullets and blade attacks to unlock the mystery behind his repetitive and untimely demise. Action comedy, starring Frank Grillo

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on Big Brother: The Launch, Don't Look Down for SU2C, Antiques Roadshow, Coronation Street, Big Little Journeys, Beat the Chasers Celebrity Special and Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg. From October 2023

programme.title: Dating Naked
programme.desc: A businessman and a bad boy compete to impress Kerri, while Chris feels that sparks are not flying between him and his keepers

programme.title: Naked Attraction: All Out & Proud
programme.desc: Anna Richardson hosts a Pride special, celebrating all of the most memorable singletons from across the sexual spectrum. Plus, a chance to catch up with some of the unforgettable pickers, including 75-year-old bisexual Ian - the show's oldest ever picker, Raheem the professional dancer looking to 'pop his gay cherry', and transfeminine singleton Callie, who came on the show to find her first 'proper' date

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on Michael McIntyre's The Wheel, Love is Blind, Strictly Come Dancing, Boiling Point, HELP! My House is Haunted, All Creatures Great and Small and Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Gregory is hesitant when kids start hanging out in his classroom at lunch, looking to him for advice as the "cool teacher." Barbara is shocked to find Tariq is dating the mother of one of her students. Janine and Jacob try to hire an ASL interpreter.

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Ava notices that not everything is rosy in Barbara's church choir group. Gregory is worried about Jacob and Zach's relationship. Melissa asks Janine to help her investigate an apparently unqualified new substitute teacher

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Members of the family appear as characters in a trilogy of classical stories. Bart plays Hamlet trying to avenge his father's death, Lisa pits the French against the English as Joan of Arc, and Homer acts the part of Ulysses in the Odyssey

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa joins an environmental protection group and begins campaigning in a last-ditch attempt to prevent the city's oldest redwood tree being felled by a rich Texan. With the voice of Joshua Jackson

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Erica is appalled when Geoff arranges for them to go out to dinner with her family to celebrate her birthday. Geoff soon discovers that dinner with the Goldbergs is no ordinary meal out: the family repeatedly change tables, Murray insists Adam order from the children's menu, the food is sent back to the kitchen, and Barry wants to amend his order but Beverly won't allow it. By the end of the evening, Geoff reaches breaking-point

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The return of the American comedy about a man and his extended family living in three different households. Recent events force Haley and Andy to cope with their emotions in different ways, while Jay and Gloria are in for a shock when they start looking for a pre-school for Joe. Plus, Cam attempts to remain supportive of Mitch's midlife career crisis, but when money begins to get tight, he hatches a plan. Ed O'Neill Stars

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil and Claire feel rejected when Alex deliberately tells them the wrong date for her moving-in day at college as she wants to keep things as low-key as possible, while Luke makes it clear he would rather hang out with schoolfriends than spend the day with his dad. Elsewhere, the rest of the family come up with an elaborate excuse to avoid going to Lily's football game, and things get stressful for Mitch and Cam now after they decided to rent out their top floor

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil helps Haley persuade Claire to let Dylan move in, but he soon has second thoughts after he discovers just what living with him really means. Meanwhile, Mitch takes on a much-needed new role working for Jay's business rivals Closets, Closets, Closets, Closets! and Gloria and Cameron come to blows over how to deal with Manny's problem at school.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil goes into nesting mode after finding some abandoned duck eggs, while Mitchell worries about Cam's friendship with a group of frat boys. American comedy following the lives of three dysfunctional households, starring Ed O'Neill and Julie Bowen

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil and Claire aren't too happy when Haley starts spending a lot of time with Andy. Gloria announces she wants Manny to learn Spanish, so hires a dashing teacher for him, and Cameron and Mitchell make the headlines after meeting a news reporter at a school function

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil steps up to the plate to cook Thanksgiving dinner, employing Luke as his sous chef. However, Claire is not convinced the pair can pull it off, so buys a back-up bird. Jay and Gloria's plan to go away for the holiday is scuppered, so the pair decide to maintain a low profile. Meanwhile, Mitch forces Cam to play bad cop when Lily refuses to wear a nice dress. Nigella Lawson guest stars

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
programme.desc: Comedy clips showcasing amusing internet videos on the themes of food and animals

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Young Brighton couple Hannah and Luke kick off the competition with an ambitiously trendy menu, then more experienced hosts Karen and Mark step up to the plate the next day, followed by Rachel and TJ, who have given nothing away to their fellow hosts

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to Mike & Nellie's Steakhouse in Oakhurst, New Jersey, where owner Mike Farber is mourning his father Nellie, who was also his business partner. Having been called in by the restaurateur's two daughters, Gordon faces the task of getting him to focus on his business, before tackling the bigger problem of rotting decor and a less-than-appealing menu

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay travels to the El Greco restaurant in Austin, Texas, where the owners have resorted to using a microwave to prepare their 'authentic' Greek dishes. Gordon faces the difficult task of uniting a squabbling family before tackling the bigger problem of a business on the brink of collapse

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Alfonso Ribeiro presents memorable moments including children's birthday blunders, the ongoing battle of man versus dog and the neighbourhood's clumsiest individuals

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: The irrepressible Will takes it upon himself to entertain the guests at Ashley's slumber party. Will Smith and Tatyana Ali star

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will gets into the festive mood by trimming the Banks' home with Christmas decorations - but his over-the-top ideas are not exactly taken in good spirit. Will Smith and James Avery star

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Springfield Elementary is threatened with closure over poor test scores, until it is revealed that one student missed the exam and could potentially save the school with an above-average mark. Unfortunately, that pupil turns out to be Bart - can he pull it out of the bag?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A tornado hits Springfield and Marge and Homer have a brush with death that prompts them to think about who would look after their kids if the worst were to happen. But finding suitable guardians for their brood is no easy feat - until they bump into super-cool couple Mav and Portia. He's a surfer and she's an environmental lawyer - but are they just too good to be true?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart's dream girl Mary Spuckler comes to town, but their relationship turns sour when he fails to pay her enough attention. Meanwhile, Homer lands himself in the doghouse after upsetting Marge once too often. With the guest voices of Benedict Cumberbatch and Zooey Deschanel

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart and Milhouse sample the perks of adulthood when a shaving experiment leaves one of the boys looking exactly like his father. Meanwhile, a preoccupied Marge tries to protect Maggie from the dangers of children's TV

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam sets out to create a sequel to Raiders of the Lost Ark as he admires director Steven Spielberg so much that he has written an original script about Indiana Jones, but his passion for directing is challenged in the process. Barry bets Murray he knows where to find the best cheesesteak sandwich ever, so they drive to New Jersey to settle the issue

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: When Beverly catches a glimpse of her soon-to-be empty nest, she replaces her children with the Mellor brothers, nursing Coach Mellor back to health after he falls off the rope climbing equipment. Meanwhile, Erica and her college room-mate get on each other's nerves

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Claire takes Haley and Alex into the office for Bring your Daughter to Work Day, while Phil joins Luke and Manny's class for a community service day that offers more lessons than expected. Meanwhile, Gloria is delighted to learn she has been chosen for jury duty, while Cam and Mitchell are in need of a mediator when they start bickering over who to invite to their party

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Claire and Phil have a lot on their plate when Luke is arrested for driving without a licence and they catch Alex coming out of a liquor store. Meanwhile, Cam encourages Gloria to recreate and sell her family's special hot sauce, Mitch helps Jay shoot a video and things get awkward when Haley and Dylan run into Andy and Beth at the cinema

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: A new house on Phil's books proves irresistible to the rest of the family, with Haley getting caught in the act by Andy when she tests out its 16-jet hot tub. Cam and Mitch pay the property a visit as they try to put the spark back into their relationship, but their night of romance is interrupted by others sneaking in with the same idea. Elsewhere, Gloria and Jay prepare to pull off a surprise for everyone

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: There is scepticism, competition and high emotions when Gloria wins a bid at the school auction for a family seminar with famous doctor and author Debra Radcliffe, whose self-help book, Clean Out Your Junk Drawer, encourages people to get out all their emotional junk to become healthier people and better partners and spouses

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Aliens Kodos and Kang probe Homer's memory, viewing a series of episodes from his life - all of which convince them humanity does not deserve to exist. Fortunately, Lisa talks them into exploring the innocent mind of a child instead. Featuring the guest voices of Alec Baldwin, Kim Basinger, Stephen Hawking, Elton John, Ron Howard and U2

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart creates a comic featuring an angry character based on Homer - who is initially enraged by an animated online version, but later vows to make more of an effort to control his temper in future. Featuring the voice of comic-book writer Stan Lee

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa is made to take extra gymnastics classes with a group of college-age students. Meanwhile, Bart catches a highly contagious virus and has to live in a plastic bubble to avoid infecting anyone else. With the guest voice of poet Robert Pinsky

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer is accused of killing a rare insect and sentenced to deliver meals to the elderly as part of a community service order - only to be suspected of murdering an old woman on his round. With the voice of Carmen Electra

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: As the Thanksgiving holiday approaches, Mr Burns hires Homer to amuse him by playing pranks on all and sundry - a situation that upsets Lisa, who has all sorts of old-fashioned ideas about dignity being more important than money

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Ava and Janine are delighted when the school is named a Philadelphia historical landmark, but it only highlights the fact that it's named after a racist. So Janine sets out to find a more appropriate Willard R Abbott to honour instead

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: R&B singer Tevin Campbell plays teen idol Little T, who surprises Ashley on her birthday with a special song and an invitation for a date. It remains to be seen whether Philip will consent. Guest starring Tevin Campbell

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Hilary's new boss gives her a complicated ultimatum - Will must date the team leader if the junior is to keep her new job as personal assistant to a movie star. American comedy, guest starring Queen Latifah

programme.title: The Inbetweeners Movie
programme.desc: Comedy based on the popular TV series, starring Simon Bird, Joe Thomas, James Buckley and Blake Harrison. Four friends go on holiday to the Greek party town of Malia, where the potent mix of sun, booze and teenage hormones leads to trouble.

programme.title: Four in a Bed

Ronnie and Steph are blown away by the competition, but they think that perfection comes at a price

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Pharaohs at War
programme.desc: The Battle of Kadesh, fought in 1275 BCE between the Egyptian Empire led by pharaoh Ramesses II and the Hittite Empire led by king Muwatalli II. In one of the world's largest chariot battles, fought beside the Orontes River, Ramses sought to wrest Canaan and Syria from the Hittites and recapture the city of Kadesh. There was a day of carnage as approximately 5,000 chariots charged into the fray, but no outright victor. Ultimately, the battle led to the world's first recorded peace treaty

programme.title: Medieval Murder Mysteries
programme.desc: This episode revisits Rome in 1497, when a richly attired but brutally mutilated body was pulled from the Tiber River. He would soon be identified as one Borgia, a son of the head of the Holy Roman Empire Pope Alexander the Sixth. Stabbed as many as eight times and his throat slashed, this was no random attack. Here, modern experts try to identify his killer

programme.title: Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code
programme.desc: The presenter dives deeper into Egypt's mysteries, exploring the Great Sphinx and the underground Serapeum with its precision-cut granite sarcophagi, questioning their purpose and links to the pyramid enigma. Travelling south, he visits the intricately designed Dendera Temple, where hieroglyphs and imagery hint at possible extraterrestrial connections. He concludes at the sprawling Karnak temple complex, marvelling at its monumental engineering, sphinx-lined avenues, and Hatshepsut's towering obelisk - wondering whether it's simply a monument or a channel for cosmic energy

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels to South Africa to explore how the lure of riches led Britain into barbaric wars, dividing the country along racial lines. He visits the crumbling Fort Napier, the British garrison in Natal, where battles were planned and executed against the Zulu people. The white minority devised rules to subdue the native black population, corralling people into squalid townships and offering them menial jobs. Eventual conflict with the descendants of Dutch settlers - Boers - was inevitable. Michael learns how Mohandas Gandhi fought the racial segregation that would later calcify into Apartheid
