programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In the first of a two-part edition, Gordon Ramsay heads to La Galleria 33 in Boston, Massachusetts, an Italian restaurant run by sisters Rita and Lisa. The pair grew up working at their father's eatery nearby, but when they opened their own business, they couldn't replicate his success, and they now blame their failure on everything from the weather to the tablecloths

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In the conclusion of Gordon Ramsay's visit to La Galleria 33 in Boston, Massachusetts, he confronts sisters Rita and Lisa with an ultimatum, and finds himself stuck in a war between the waiters, chefs and owners over who is to blame for the Italian restaurant's failings

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Johnny Vegas and Romesh Ranganathan join host Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock for more comic innuendos, unpredictable conundrums and unforgivable puns in the words-and-numbers game. Josie Long is with Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while comedian Joe Wilkinson 'helps' Rachel Riley with her mathematical sums and duties

programme.title: Joe Lycett: I'm About to Lose Control and I Think Joe Lycett
programme.desc: In a gig recorded at the Hammersmith Apollo, London, Joe Lycett shares jokes, paintings and some of the pathetic trolling he's been up to, such as breaking into banks, selling art for £12.5million and taking on bronze medal-winning Olympians

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by guests Jack Dee, Steve Jones, David O'Doherty and Jamelia to answer questions based on opinion polls carried out around the country to see who best understands what is going on in Britain today. Jimmy Carr hosts the topical panel show

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the irreverent panel show, with team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson joined by Richard Hammond, Carol Vorderman, Paul Foot and Matt Forde to see who best understands what is going on in Britain

programme.title: Boss Level
programme.desc: Former Special Forces operative Roy Pulver wakes every day in his apartment with a beautiful woman in his bed and assassins trying to kill him. Stuck in a time loop, Roy must dodge bullets and blade attacks to unlock the mystery behind his repetitive and untimely demise. Action comedy, starring Frank Grillo

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Sasha Luss, Luke Evans and Helen Mirren. A young Russian woman fleeing her abusive home is recruited to the KGB and trained as an assassin. Initially, Anna is told she will be employed for only five years and then allowed a comfy retirement, but she soon discovers her handlers have other plans and a deadly game of survival begins.

programme.title: Dora and the Lost City of Gold
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Isabela Moner. Sixteen-year-old Dora has grown up in the Peruvian rainforest with her zoologist mother and archaeologist father. When her parents head off on a dangerous mission to find a lost Incan city, Dora finds herself in uncharted territory: a Los Angeles high school - but arriving in this strange new world is just the beginning of a new adventure.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Comedy starring Beattie Edmondson. Teacher Sarah is gifted her grandmother's spoiled prize pug, Patrick. Though Sarah at first struggles to cope, she soon develops a bond with the pampered pooch and is eventually led towards success in her professional and personal lives.

programme.title: All That Heaven Allows
programme.desc: Melodrama starring Jane Wyman and Rock Hudson. Wealthy widow Cary Scott, after years of shunning company, falls in love with gardener Ron Kirby, who is 15 years her junior. The difference in social status as well as their age shocks her family and friends, and soon their relationship is affected by gossip.

programme.title: The Golden Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Phillip Law, Caroline Munro and Tom Baker. Sinbad acquires part of a magical golden amulet but when he sets sail to find the remainder, he comes up against the evil forces of the magician Koura.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Tessa Thompson and Chris Hemsworth. Agent M, an eager rookie in the secret MIB organiation, is sent to the London office where she's partnered with laid-back Agent H. When their first assignment together ends in disaster, M begins to suspect a mole must have infiltrated the agency. But who could it be - and is her partner to be trusted?

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Sci-fi action prequel starring Amber Midthunder and Dane DiLiegro. Eighteenth-century Comanche healer Naru wishes to hunt and fight like the men in her tribe. When a mysterious entity that leaves strange tracks begins to attack the local wildlife, Naru has a chance to prove herself - but this predator is unlike anything on Earth...

programme.title: Cocaine Bear
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Keri Russell. A black bear stumbles across an abandoned stash of cocaine in a Tennessee forest. When it eats some of the drug, the bear is sent on a violent rampage, endangering various hikers, rangers and drug dealers, as well as nurse Sari - whose daughter has skipped school to spend a day in the woods.

programme.title: Predator
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. A rescue mission deep in the Central American jungle turns into a fight for survival as a crack commando unit, led by Major "Dutch" Schaeffer, comes up against an unseen enemy - a predator able to resist the most up-to-date weaponry and kill with relentless efficiency.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team refresh and preserve three prized keepsakes, sparking fond memories of loved ones.
The day's first restoration falls to music box maestro Steve Kember. Marie Ayears arrives with a musical Grenadier Guard doll. Marie's dad served with the Grenadier Guards in the 1950s and was on duty in Westminster Abbey for Queen Elizabeth's coronation in 1953. The music box was bought by Marie's proud grandmother to mark the occasion. It is supposed to play the tune Auld Lang Syne, but Marie fears she may have overwound him, and now the mechanism is jammed. While Steve attempts to repair the music box, toy restorers Julie Tatchell and Amanda Middleditch must try and get his tired-looking unform fit for inspection.
Alice Ellingham and her mum June are next to arrive at the barn. They've brought in a sextant, used for navigation at sea by June's late husband Bob. Bob joined the Merchant Navy aged 16 and retired as captain of a cruise ship. The sextant was with him throughout his career and would have been a vital navigational tool in the days before GPS. Alice and June are both enormously proud of Bob's career and are hopeful Steve Fletcher can restore the instrument back to its pristine best so they can learn to use it as a way of connecting with Bob's past.
The day's final visitor is Rohan Gunatillake from Glasgow. He's the custodian of an unusual-looking chest that came from his grandmother's house in Sri Lanka and now serves as a connection to Rohan's Sri Lankan heritage. Rohan's grandmother lived in rural Sri Lanka on a farm surrounded by rubber trees, paddy fields and water buffalo. For Rohan, summer trips to see her were like visiting another world and made a lasting impression. Over time, sections of the chest have broken off, presenting a big challenge for furniture restorer Will Kirk. The chest is also missing a brass handle and casting a new one falls to silversmith Brenton West.

As ever, correctness and even intelligence go out of the window, as the fiendishly difficult questions lead to points being awarded for the answers its questionmaster finds most interesting, as opposed to correct

programme.title: Rick Stein: From Venice to Istanbul

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: How animals in the polar regions adapt to the summer weather. In a colony of 400,000 king penguins the adults go surfing and the chicks take mud-baths to cool off, while polar bear cubs take their first swimming lessons as the ice they inhabit melts away. A minke whale is hunted by a family of killer whales, succumbing to their battering after two hours, and Adelie penguins try to prevent their chicks being snatched by skuas

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: With the arrival of autumn the Arctic Ocean begins freezing over, and polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast as they await the return of the ice. Two thousand beluga whales head for a particular estuary to thrash against the gravel and exfoliate, while in Antarctica, Adelie penguins take to the sea for the first time and face the danger of leopard seal attacks

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines how the arrival of winter sparks a ruthless battle for survival in the polar regions, with temperatures plummeting to -70C, winds reaching 120mph and day-long darkness. As a blizzard rages, a polar bear treks into the Arctic mountains to give birth, while the entire world population of spectacled eider braves the weather in a giant ice hole. Wolves and bison engage in battle, but alliances are also made, and beneath the snow, voles try to dodge the attacks of great grey owls and weasels

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the life and work of people in the polar regions, including the residents of Norilsk in Siberia, the coldest city on Earth. He also discovers how the Danish armed forces maintain their country's claim to Greenland's natural resources by mounting a 2,000-mile dog sled patrol during the winter, and finds out how a research base at the South Pole is able to cope with being cut off from the outside world for six months at a time

He also discovers how the Danish armed forces maintain their country's claim to Greenland's natural resources by mounting a 2,000-mile dog sled patrol during the winter, and finds out how a research base at the South Pole is able to cope with being cut off from the outside world for six months at a time

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: How animals in the polar regions adapt to the summer weather. In a colony of 400,000 king penguins the adults go surfing and the chicks take mud-baths to cool off, while polar bear cubs take their first swimming lessons as the ice they inhabit melts away. A minke whale is hunted by a family of killer whales, succumbing to their battering after two hours, and Adelie penguins try to prevent their chicks being snatched by skuas

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: With the arrival of autumn the Arctic Ocean begins freezing over, and polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast as they await the return of the ice. Two thousand beluga whales head for a particular estuary to thrash against the gravel and exfoliate, while in Antarctica, Adelie penguins take to the sea for the first time and face the danger of leopard seal attacks

And although Spanish nurses Carlota and Javier epitomise the perfect relationship, the pair realise that labour can be challenging even for the best of partnerships

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part one of three. Yvonne is suspended from duty pending further investigation into the death of young thug Lee Thomas, and Leela is also accused of assaulting a suspect, leaving the relief uncertain as to what constitutes reasonable force when making an arrest. Fearful of leaving himself open to accusations of heavy-handedness or police brutality, Tony later hesitates to use force in a confrontation with local youths - and suffers a horrific beating. Meanwhile Zain Nadir agrees to do a stint in CID before beginning his next undercover job

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part two of three. As Tony recovers in hospital, Gabriel and Roger are disciplined for using their CS spray in a tense situation, prompting June to stand up for coppers' rights and call the demoralised relief out on strike. Unfortunately for Lance, he's already been dragged out on an unauthorised mission by Zain Nadir, and ends up being held at gunpoint by a local gangster. On the personal front, Phil receives the shocking news that Kate Maltby has been rushed to hospital and might lose their baby, while Dan receives a letter in the internal mail from someone who clearly knows about his affair with Sun Hill newcomer Rochelle Barratt

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part three of three. Adam tries to defuse the threat of strike action by the relief, reminding them of their duties as police officers and offering to let Yvonne return to the station while the inquiry takes its course. Dan reacts with dismay when Rochelle suggests they put their affair on hold, Gary chafes under Suzie's condescending attitude, and Samantha looks on in disbelief as the simmering hostility between brothers Phil and Steve erupts into violence

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part one of two. Laura looks at Gabriel with new eyes when he takes a surprisingly compassionate approach to her wayward son Liam, who is being bullied because of her job. Adam tries to mend fences with the rank-and-file officers by going out on the beat with June - only to lose his cool completely when a traffic accident triggers painful memories. Samantha jeopardises Jo's investigation by poaching her informant, leading to a bitter row, while Gary's future on the force looks uncertain after he reacts to Suzie's constant needling with a very public outburst

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part two of two. Laura begins to feel increasingly unfulfilled in her role as PCSO, and announces to Smithy that she wants to become a PC. Gina's old flame Jonathan Fox returns to Sun Hill, and Neil pressures Gary to drop his bullying accusations against Susie Sim. Gabriel warns an increasingly infatuated Sheelagh not to get involved with him, while Samantha continues to needle Jo, fuelling an already volatile situation

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Terry appears in court to testify against brother Ben, but reacts badly to being questioned about his own childhood abuse, indirectly jeopardising the outcome of the trial. Phil begins to realise he is powerless to stop former lover Christine emigrating with their daughter Madison, while Smithy spends the night with sultry Louise Larson, unaware Zain Nadir is investigating the criminal activities of her husband Pete

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: A man is left with a metal spike impaled in his face after a traumatic incident on a construction site, sparking a huge rescue operation. Medics help a man who was hit by a car

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: A woman plunges 10ft through the floorboards of her Sheffield home in a freak accident, and the HART team launch a major rescue operation to save her.

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: There's a major rescue operation on the M1 after a car towing a caravan rolls over and hits a lamp post - trapping the driver. A teacher out on his mountain bike suffers a brain injury.

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: The team helps a biker critically injured in a crash, and a man vanishes after going for a swim in a Pennines lake, sparking a major rescue operation.

programme.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
programme.desc: Pete helps rescue a Shar Pei cross whose time is running out, befriends a poorly Shih Tzu and supports a vulnerable litter of Malamute puppies.

programme.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
programme.desc: An eight-year-old is having an operation to straighten his squint, a man needs an ultrasound to confirm whether he has cancer and a new mum is having her wisdom teeth removed.

programme.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
programme.desc: A 15-year-old has four baby teeth that have not fallen out and need removing, a man is having his urethra widened so that a camera can pass into his bladder to check his cancer has not returned and a woman needs an operation to stop her persistent nose bleeds

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2004
programme.desc: Ben bemoans the fact that one day of Christmas is bad enough without having to endure the full 12, while Susan tries to display her culinary 'talents', Michael feels his girlfriend is getting too serious, and Janey comes home with something unexpected and unwanted. Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker star

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2005
programme.desc: Another Christmas with the Harper family sees Scrooge-like patriarch Ben at his most miserable, as wife Susan is busy giving grandson Kenzo a third birthday to remember, his hated mother-in-law Grace gets herself a toyboy and eldest son Nick sends a present that could have a lasting effect on the entire household. Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker star, with Daniela Denby-Ashe, Gabriel Thomson, Siobhan Hayes and Rosemary Leach

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2006
programme.desc: The Harpers are looking forward to another Christmas - except for Scrooge-like dad Ben, who this year comes up with a cunning plan, feigning a mystery illness to escape the festivities. Susan is unconvinced, but nonetheless drags him to the doctor, who admits the grumpy dentist to hospital. With him out of the way, son Michael and lodger Alfie organise a last-minute party, while Janey is too busy trying to get the must-have toy for Kenzo, whether he wants it or not. But the party atmosphere is dampened somewhat by news from the hospital - Ben's test results are back and he needs surgery. Festive special of the comedy from 2006, starring Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker

programme.title: Psychopath with Piers Morgan
programme.desc: In 2007, when Paris Bennett was 13 years old, stabbed his four-year-old sister to death, a crime for which he has been behind bars ever since. Now 25 and in his first interview on British television, he tells Piers Morgan how this was no impulsive fit of rage but rather a cold, deliberate act planned as an act of revenge against his mother Charity - who is watching the interview unfold in a nearby room. She has stood by him even though she fears that when he gets out, he could still harbour violent intentions towards her - or even worse, towards his younger brother

programme.desc: Following his visit to the Great Barrier Reef in 1957, naturalist and broadcaster David Attenborough returns and uses the latest filming techniques to unlock the secrets of the natural wonder. He also learns about a complex community of animals, as well as the annual coral spawning, which is responsible for the great diversity in the reef

He also marvels at manta ray cleaning stations on Lady Elliot Island, and tracks dwarf minke whales to discover their surprising reasons for returning, and why the reef is vital for their survival

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The naturalist examines what the next few decades may hold for this remarkable ecosystem, and looks at the work of scientists who are trying to preserve the area and the species that inhabit it, assisted by research vessel the Alucia. programme.title: The Yorkshire Auction House

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Organ builder David Burville takes on the repair of a vintage harmonium, brought into the Repair Shop by Marian Stanley. Marian's family come from Stepney in London's East End, and she has many fond memories of the harmonium and the festive gatherings for which it provided the soundtrack, with family members of different generations all taking their turn at the keyboard. However, the harmonium is now over a hundred years old and hasn't played a tune in decades. With leaky bellows, broken reeds and cracked and chipped casing, David has a massive job on his hands to get it playing again.
Ceramics conservator Kirsten Ramsay also faces a daunting challenge in the shape of a ceramic dish that was smashed to bits 25 years ago by then-13-year-old Karen Barnett. The dish was Karen's father Richard's pride and joy, and Karen has lived with the guilt ever since.
And Jay leads the repair of a hand-crafted doll's house with a touching story behind it. As a young girl, on her daily walk to school with her grandfather, Debbie White would pass the same black and white house every morning. Debbie loved the house so much that her grandfather promised her that one day she would have it. And the following Christmas, there it was under the tree in miniature form, handmade by her grandfather. Debbie has treasured the doll's house ever since, but now rickety and in danger of collapsing, it takes the combined efforts of Jay, furniture restorer Will Kirk and art conservator Lucia Scalisi to return the beloved toy to its former splendour.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Ninety-three-year-old D-Day veteran Thomas Hassell brings along a treasured item with a proud history - a smart military swagger stick awarded to him while on army service in Berlin for consistently being the smartest soldier on parade. The stick is a cherished symbol of a long and proud career, but sadly the decades have not been kind, and the silver head is badly dented and discoloured. It's down to silversmith Brenton West to knock out the dents and give the stick its swagger back. The team also restores a miniature whisky barrel and an antique set of scales

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Music box restorer Stephen Kember mends a much-cherished but sadly long mute music box, clockmaker Steven Fletcher and furniture restorer Will Kirk breathe new life into a dilapidated penny arcade machine, while soft toy supremos Amanda Middleditch and Julie Tatchell try to rehabilitate a threadbare horse on wheels. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
A tired-looking and dilapidated old rocking horse arrives at the barn, requiring the joint attention of furniture restorer Will Kirk and saddlery expert Suzie Fletcher. The rocking horse has been part of owner Julie's life since childhood, but after she carried out a bodged renovation with her husband Paul, they had always planned to return to the job and make a second attempt at restoration together. Sadly, before they could begin, Paul was diagnosed with terminal cancer and passed away just a few weeks ago. Now Julie has grandchildren on the way, so needs Will and Suzie to help keep Paul's dream alive and revive this much-loved heirloom for future generations.
Storm clouds gather for horologist Steve Fletcher as he attempts to revive a century-old barograph. This remarkable device was invented at a time of Victorian ingenuity to test and record weather pressure, and is now the proud possession of meteorology student Ollie, who is keen to use it to help prepare his online weather forecasts. Not only does the whole clock mechanism need a full overhaul, but the whole thing is thick with grime, meaning Steve has a challenge on his hands to get the clockwork mechanism working once more.
And pinball wizard Geoffrey Harvey has great fun bringing a vintage machine ricocheting back to life.

programme.title: People's Palaces: The Golden Age of Civic Architecture
programme.desc: Part one of two. Architectural historian Dr Jonathan Foyle explores some of the most impressive Georgian and Victorian buildings in the north of England, beginning with neo-classical constructions. He visits town and concert halls, libraries, schools and galleries in Liverpool, Leeds, Bradford and Manchester to find out how the regular proportion and symmetry of the style was intended to suggest order in chaotically expanding urban environments

programme.title: Britain's Most Fragile Treasure

Maine 1946: sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife and her lover, mild-mannered banker Andy Dufresne tries to adapt to the brutalities of prison life. Over the years, Dufresne's friendship with long-term inmate Red and the discovery that his financial expertise is suddenly in big demand make his ordeal easier to bear.

programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Fantasy prison drama based on the novel by Stephen King, starring Tom Hanks and featuring Michael Clarke Duncan. Retired warder Paul Edgecomb remembers his time in charge of death-row inmates in a Louisiana penitentiary, and the strange powers of convicted child killer John Coffey.

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Spoof western starring Cleavon Little and Gene Wilder. Sheriff Bart fights prejudice and corruption to save the little town of Rock Ridge from wicked speculator Hedley Lamarr, helped by the once legendary Waco Kid.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Comedy starring Kristen Wiig and Rose Byrne. After Lillian announces her engagement, she asks her lifelong pal Annie to be her maid of honour. However, Annie's life is in a mess, and she finds herself losing control over the bachelorette party to Lillian's seemingly perfect new friend Helen.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young. Eccentric investigator Ace Ventura is hired to discover who is behind the mysterious kidnapping of the Miami Dolphins football team mascot, a dolphin called Snowflake, just a week before the Super Bowl.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. The new mayor of an American city decides to change the rules to allow anyone to join the police force. The decision proves to be a recipe for unadulterated chaos.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. When cutbacks mean the closure of one of the state's two police academies, both institutions become locked in a desperate battle for survival.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the hit US TV series, starring Denzel Washington. On the face of it, Robert McCall is just an ordinary guy who works at a DIY store and leads a quiet life. But when McCall befriends a young girl controlled by ruthless Russian gangsters, he's unable to stand idly by and resorts to using skills from his shady former career.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Denzel Washington and Pedro Pascal. Now living a peaceful life, former Marine and government agent Robert McCall offers his singular skills pro bono to those in need. However, when his friend is killed under suspicious circumstances, McCall investigates, and uses any means necessary to see justice served.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happiness
programme.desc: A student driver lands himself in trouble with the police after hitting a pedestrian, and finds his aggressive attitude only makes matters worse. Drama, starring Barbara Hershey, Michael Sarrazin, Arthur Hill and EG Marshall

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: Musical drama starring Jennifer Beals as Alex Owens, a welder who longs to become a ballet dancer. In the meantime, Alex dances at the bar frequented by her co-workers, waiting for the big break that will help her realise her dreams.

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: Biographical romantic drama starring Haley Bennett. In 1805 France, Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin Clicquot is suddenly widowed at just 27 years old, but vows to continue her late husband's champagne business. Though many, including her father-in-law, are sceptical, Barbe-Nicole works tirelessly to innovate and succeed.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on Ronald Harwood's play, directed by Dustin Hoffman and starring Maggie Smith, Tom Courtenay and Billy Connolly. At the Beecham House retirement home for opera singers, the occasion of Verdi's birthday is always marked by a special fundraising concert. But this year the arrival of one particular grande dame throws preparations into chaos as egos clash and old resentments surface.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Adventure drama starring Tom Hanks and Helen Hunt. Workaholic executive Chuck Noland is looking forward to spending Christmas with his girlfriend, but is sent abroad on an assignment at the last minute. When his plane crashes into the Pacific, Chuck is stranded alone on a remote, uninhabited island.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: Lee
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Kate Winslet. As the Second World War rages, American fashion model-turned-photographer Elizabeth "Lee" Miller defies the expectations of the era and travels to mainland Europe as a war correspondent for Vogue. Reporting from the frontline, Miller captures indelible images of the conflict, including the horrors found in the Nazi concentration camps at Buchenwald and Dachau.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: Pillion
programme.desc: Romantic comedy drama starring Harry Melling and Alexander Skarsgård. Colin, a meek 30-something parking inspector who lives with his parents, encounters the tall, handsome and enigmatic Ray. They begin a sexual relationship based around a strict dom/sub power dynamic, but as time goes by the ever-obliging Colin yearns for more tenderness from his leather-clad master.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy starring Bill Murray, Sigourney Weaver and Dan Aykroyd. Three university professors researching parapsychology set up in business for themselves when their grant is withdrawn, and soon realise there's a burgeoning market for "ghost busters" in New York City.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy sequel starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver and Harold Ramis. The Ghostbusters are reunited when their old client Dana Barrett calls for help. Now a single parent with an eight-month-old baby son, she is once again having problems with supernatural phenomena.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Killer Sequels
programme.desc: From Scream 7 to The Conjuring: Last Rites, prepare for blood-curdling sequels and some seriously sinister scares

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from the director of The Shape of Water, starring Charlie Hunnam and Idris Elba. In an epic war between colossal monsters from under the sea and gigantic human-controlled robots, it's up to two unlikely heroes to save mankind.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Benedict Cumberbatch. Captain Kirk's disdain for protocol sees him stripped of the command of the Enterprise, but he is given a chance to prove himself after volunteering to find and stop a mysterious operative who's out to destroy Starfleet.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy starring Bill Murray, Sigourney Weaver and Dan Aykroyd. Three university professors researching parapsychology set up in business for themselves when their grant is withdrawn, and soon realise there's a burgeoning market for "ghost busters" in New York City.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Tommy Lee Jones and Will Smith. When a New York police officer is recruited by a top-secret agency that monitors alien activity he finds himself in a race against time to save the Earth from destruction.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy sequel starring Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones. When evil alien queen Serleena threatens Earth's safety, former intergalactic secret agent Kay holds the secret to her destruction. However, Kay is now living a civilian life as a post-office worker and his memory of the past has been erased. Can his former partner Jay persuade him to rejoin the sharp-suited Men in Black and save the world?

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Science-fiction comedy starring Will Smith and Josh Brolin. The fight against aliens is taken to a new dimension when Agent J is forced to travel back to 1969 in an effort to prevent his partner's murder by ruthless fugitive Boris the Animal.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Benedict Cumberbatch. Captain Kirk's disdain for protocol sees him stripped of the command of the Enterprise, but he is given a chance to prove himself after volunteering to find and stop a mysterious operative who's out to destroy Starfleet.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Woody Harrelson and Jesse Eisenberg. Four mismatched people form a reluctant alliance in a world overrun by zombies and drive west, where they hope a Californian amusement park will be the ideal place to ride out the undead storm.

programme.title: Cocaine Bear
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Keri Russell. A black bear stumbles across an abandoned stash of cocaine in a Tennessee forest. When it eats some of the drug, the bear is sent on a violent rampage, endangering various hikers, rangers and drug dealers, as well as nurse Sari - whose daughter has skipped school to spend a day in the woods.

programme.title: Glass
programme.desc: Fantasy thriller starring Bruce Willis, Samuel L Jackson and James McAvoy. "Unbreakable" vigilante David Dunn tracks down and confronts Kevin Wendell Crumb, a man with multiple personalities. The two are arrested and sent to a psychiatric ward, alongside the villainous superhero expert Elijah Price, aka Mr Glass. Their doctor believes the trio suffer from delusions of grandeur, but Price is determined to prove otherwise.

programme.title: The Man from Colorado
programme.desc: Psychological western starring Glenn Ford and William Holden. When unstable Civil War veteran Owen Devereaux becomes a judge in Colorado, his marshal, Del Stewart, tries to keep his ex-army colleague's psychotic tendencies under control.

programme.title: Sea Wife
programme.desc: Second World War romantic adventure starring Joan Collins and Richard Burton. After their ship is torpedoed off Singapore, an RAF officer is cast adrift with three other survivors and becomes attracted to the only woman among them.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring James Marsden, Jim Carrey and the voice of Ben Schwartz. Hunted for his incredible powers, super speedy alien Sonic lives a lonely life in hiding on Earth. When he accidentally causes a power surge, Sonic is thrown into the orbit of kindly local sheriff Tom - but also that of unhinged scientist Dr Robotnik.

programme.title: Spies in Disguise
programme.desc: Animated spy comedy featuring the voices of Will Smith and Tom Holland. After inadvertently ingesting a secret formula invented by young scientist Walter Beckett, arrogant super spy Lance Sterling finds himself turned into a pigeon. The newly feathered agent teams up with Walter to foil a terrorist plot - and work out how to get back to his suave human form.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Anthony Ramos and Dominique Fishback. New York, 1994: when planet-devouring entity Unicron and its Terrorcon minions turn their attention to Earth, Optimus Prime and his fellow Autobots must combine forces with the beast-like Maximals to repel the threat. As conflict erupts, museum researcher Elena and former soldier Noah are caught between the warring sides.

programme.desc: Western starring Kurt Russell and Val Kilmer. Arizona 1879: Wyatt Earp arrives in Tombstone to start a business, his career as a lawman behind him. But, with the town in the grip of an organised crime ring, he is soon forced to take up arms.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds and Noah Jupe. More than a year after humanity was attacked by monsters with sensitive hearing, the surviving members of the Abbott family hold the secret to killing the creatures. Followed by a troubled neighbour, hearing-impaired Regan sets out to an island radio tower, hoping to broadcast their discovery - but it isn't only the monsters she has to watch out for.

Carl Lee Hailey, a black Mississippi factory worker, shoots the two racist thugs who brutally assaulted his ten-year-old daughter. When white lawyer Jake Brigance takes on Hailey's case, long-standing tensions in the small town of Clanton come to the surface.

programme.desc: Australia v England. Coverage of the second ODI in the three-match series, which takes place at Adelaide Oval. These two sides last faced each other in this format in September 2024 when Australia travelled to England for a five-match contest. They won the first two games by seven wickets and 68 runs respectively before England fought back with a 46-run victory and a 186-run win to take the series to a decider. Australia finally came out on top with a comfortable 49-run victory in the fifth and final contest in Bristol

programme.title: Horrible Histories
programme.desc:
From the ancient Egyptians pioneering smelling good (a heady mix of fat and perfume plonked on your head, so that it would gradually melt throughout the day and make you smell all lovely and fragrant), to Coco Chanel turning fashion for women on its head, this show brings you the Horrible History of looking good.
Featuring some of fashion's greatest innovations, pioneers, and victims, we look at how the way people have dressed has had an impact on their lives. We visit ancient Rome, where wearing a cumbersome five-metre toga was the law and elsewhere, while in 'Viking Eye for the Saxon Guy' some marauding Vikings take time out of their busy pillaging schedule to give Dave the smelly Saxon some tips on looking good, and smelling a little bit better.
We visit Henry VIII, who is having online beef with the Holy Roman Emperor over (literally) dressing to kill, as they argue over who's the best armour maker. Other royals featured include Elizabeth I (who is busy making her courtiers look exactly like her), and King Louis XV who, along with some of his courtiers, has dressed as a hedge for a fancy dress party, so that he can hide from his wife.
Also, the Macaronis discover that their outrageous stylings aren't fashionable any more, the Victorians advise us on how to properly dress for mourning, and we look at some of the least practical shoes ever.

programme.title: The Avengers
programme.desc: Superhero adventure starring Robert Downey Jr, Samuel L Jackson, Chris Evans and Scarlett Johansson. When powerful energy source the Tesseract is stolen from a SHIELD base by Thor's brother Loki, the agency's director Nick Fury decides it's time for the Earth's mightiest heroes - Iron Man, Captain America and Thor himself - to band together with agents Black Widow and Hawkeye to save the planet. programme.title: Eternals
programme.desc: When monstrous entities called Deviants infest the Earth in 5000 BC Mesopotamia, an ancient race of beings known as Celestials, led by the mighty Arishem, fashion humanity's superpowered protectors, the Eternals. For more than 7,000 years, this band of near-immortal saviours live among us, in plain sight but unseen. They are instructed not to interfere in human conflicts unless Deviants are involved, and watch with dismay as humans resolve differences with bloodshed. Sci-fi adventure from Marvel Studios, starring Gemma Chan, Richard Madden, Angelina Jolie and Salma Hayek

programme.title: Cinderella

Their quest takes them to Buckingham Palace and the White House, where they uncover evidence of a lost city of gold.

Once there, he comes to the aid of a beautiful princess who is being used as a bargaining chip between warring races.

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Artistic couple Zaya and Damian kick off the competition in Cornwall with an aspirational modern British menu. Next, property developers Kelly and Jon cook a simple menu in the brand new kitchen of their newly-refurbished massive Georgian mansion, which wows their guests. And Emma and Gavin host a Cornish evening of food and fun. However, it remains to be seen who will walk away with the £1,000 cash prize

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples from Cornwall take part in the culinary challenge, with the first hosts being competitive duo Marie and Gavin, who are more than happy to receive a glowing response from one of their fellow competitors. Next up are 25-year-old Becki and her 55-year-old partner Barry, whose age-gap romance leaves their guests with a lot of questions. Finally, Sam and Nick throw the last party, but their rivals are uneasy ahead of arriving at their home, since the pair spent much of their time during a previous engagement discussing their plans for surviving a zombie apocalypse

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Ray Blanchette, CEO of restaurant chain TGI Fridays, has recently made changes to re-energise the brand. Here, he goes undercover to find out if the changes he's making to put Fridays back on top are firing up sales or burning out his staff. Taking on his alter ego Keith, a former inn keeper who now wants to start his own restaurant, Ray meets a cook, a server, an assistant manager and a bar manager

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Brooklyn, New York, to tackle a 55-year-old family business. Owner John Esposito left school at the age of 14 and has worked at his parents' restaurant, Sal's Pizzeria, ever since. Their success meant they could afford to purchase the location next door in the 1990s, naming it Mama Maria after John's mother, who died in 2002. But when he lost his father as well, John became overwhelmed by the responsibility of running both establishments and his livelihood is at risk

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Wilkinsburg in Pennsylvania, home to Ms Jean's Southern Cuisine, which was opened by retired special-education teacher Jean Gould. During the chef's attempt to save the business from disaster, he discovers her soul-food restaurant resembles a dentist's waiting room and finds a lot of tension between Jean and her employees, who claim she is a Jekyll-and-Hyde character

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef visits beachside restaurant Barefoot Bob's in Hull, Massachusetts, owned by husband-and-wife team Marc and Lisa. Every year profits nosedive through the bleak winter months, and matters aren't improved when it becomes clear they have both lost their passion - not only for the business but also for each other. With the restaurant and marriage on the line, Gordon tries to help turn things around before it's too late

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits three of the most difficult cases he has taken on since the series began. First, he returns to Cafe Hon in Baltimore, Maryland, where owner Denise Whiting was trapped in a nasty battle with the community and had threatened the locals with lawsuits. Next, the chef goes back to Chiarella's in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. When he first visited owners Tommy and Dina DeFino, the business was struggling so badly that Tommy had completely lost his confidence and wife Dina had lost her patience. On his final stop, Gordon travels to Leone's in Montclair, New Jersey, where Rose Leone was depending on her lazy son Michael to run the restaurant

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to the Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets a stubborn owner who doesn't react well to criticism. Tom bought the restaurant for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he's still refusing to let her run it. Can the chef break Tom's iron grip on the business and persuade him to change his outdated approach?

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Vic Reeves and Bob Mortimer join host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson for more comic innuendos, unpredictable conundrums and unforgivable puns in the comedy quiz. Jack Whitehall is with Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Joe Wilkinson 'helps' Rachel Riley with her mathematical sums and duties

programme.title: That's the Way, A-Ha, A-Ha, Joe Lycett
programme.desc: A performance from the comedian's award-winning live show, recorded at the Duchess Theatre in London's West End. Joe tackles topics including Post Office jobsworths, celebrities on social media and getting into an online argument. From 2018

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Alex Jones, Tinchy Stryder, David O'Doherty and Katherine Ryan to answer questions based on opinion polls carried out around the country, finding out who best understands what is going on in Britain today. Irreverent panel show, hosted by Jimmy Carr

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats

programme.title: Cocaine Bear
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Keri Russell. A black bear stumbles across an abandoned stash of cocaine in a Tennessee forest. When it eats some of the drug, the bear is sent on a violent rampage, endangering various hikers, rangers and drug dealers, as well as nurse Sari - whose daughter has skipped school to spend a day in the woods.

programme.title: Glass
programme.desc: Fantasy thriller starring Bruce Willis, Samuel L Jackson and James McAvoy. "Unbreakable" vigilante David Dunn tracks down and confronts Kevin Wendell Crumb, a man with multiple personalities. The two are arrested and sent to a psychiatric ward, alongside the villainous superhero expert Elijah Price, aka Mr Glass. Their doctor believes the trio suffer from delusions of grandeur, but Price is determined to prove otherwise.

programme.title: The Man from Colorado
programme.desc: Psychological western starring Glenn Ford and William Holden. When unstable Civil War veteran Owen Devereaux becomes a judge in Colorado, his marshal, Del Stewart, tries to keep his ex-army colleague's psychotic tendencies under control.

programme.title: Sea Wife
programme.desc: Second World War romantic adventure starring Joan Collins and Richard Burton. After their ship is torpedoed off Singapore, an RAF officer is cast adrift with three other survivors and becomes attracted to the only woman among them.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring James Marsden, Jim Carrey and the voice of Ben Schwartz. Hunted for his incredible powers, super speedy alien Sonic lives a lonely life in hiding on Earth. When he accidentally causes a power surge, Sonic is thrown into the orbit of kindly local sheriff Tom - but also that of unhinged scientist Dr Robotnik.

programme.title: Spies in Disguise
programme.desc: Animated spy comedy featuring the voices of Will Smith and Tom Holland. After inadvertently ingesting a secret formula invented by young scientist Walter Beckett, arrogant super spy Lance Sterling finds himself turned into a pigeon. The newly feathered agent teams up with Walter to foil a terrorist plot - and work out how to get back to his suave human form.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Anthony Ramos and Dominique Fishback. New York, 1994: when planet-devouring entity Unicron and its Terrorcon minions turn their attention to Earth, Optimus Prime and his fellow Autobots must combine forces with the beast-like Maximals to repel the threat. As conflict erupts, museum researcher Elena and former soldier Noah are caught between the warring sides.

programme.title: Wild Horse Nine Interview Special
programme.desc: Writer/director Martin McDonagh and cast discuss the Film4-produced political comedy thriller Wild Horse Nine.

programme.title: Tombstone
programme.desc: Western starring Kurt Russell and Val Kilmer. Arizona 1879: Wyatt Earp arrives in Tombstone to start a business, his career as a lawman behind him. But, with the town in the grip of an organised crime ring, he is soon forced to take up arms.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds and Noah Jupe. More than a year after humanity was attacked by monsters with sensitive hearing, the surviving members of the Abbott family hold the secret to killing the creatures. Followed by a troubled neighbour, hearing-impaired Regan sets out to an island radio tower, hoping to broadcast their discovery - but it isn't only the monsters she has to watch out for.

In one of the world's largest chariot battles, fought beside the Orontes River, Ramses sought to wrest Canaan and Syria from the Hittites and recapture the city of Kadesh. There was a day of carnage as approximately 5,000 chariots charged into the fray, but no outright victor. Ultimately, the battle led to the world's first recorded peace treaty

programme.title: Medieval Dead

programme.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead

programme.title: Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code
programme.desc: The presenter dives deeper into Egypt's mysteries, exploring the Great Sphinx and the underground Serapeum with its precision-cut granite sarcophagi, questioning their purpose and links to the pyramid enigma. Travelling south, he visits the intricately designed Dendera Temple, where hieroglyphs and imagery hint at possible extraterrestrial connections. He concludes at the sprawling Karnak temple complex, marvelling at its monumental engineering, sphinx-lined avenues, and Hatshepsut's towering obelisk - wondering whether it's simply a monument or a channel for cosmic energy

programme.title: Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code
programme.desc: The presenter sets out to uncover the mysteries of King Tutankhamun. Along the way, he encounters the enigmatic 'Alien King' Akhenaten and his wife, Nefertiti. Sailing down the Nile, he investigates how the Ancient Egyptians transported enormous stone blocks for their architectural marvels, including the 700-ton Colossi of Memnon. His quest then leads him into the Valley of the Kings, where he discovers the resting places of Akhenaten and King Tut's successor, Horemheb - before finally coming face to face with the mummy of the Boy King himself

Proboscis monkeys are forced to venture uncomfortably closer to humans, and swifts in Jerusalem face tough competition for nest sites

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Following his visit to the Great Barrier Reef in 1957, naturalist and broadcaster David Attenborough returns and uses the latest filming techniques to unlock the secrets of the natural wonder. In the first edition, he descends beneath the waves at night and uses cutting-edge technology to generate computer scans of the sea floor. He also learns about a complex community of animals, as well as the annual coral spawning, which is responsible for the great diversity in the reef

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough

He also marvels at manta ray cleaning stations on Lady Elliot Island, and tracks dwarf minke whales to discover their surprising reasons for returning, and why the reef is vital for their survival

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc:
Marcus Wareing explores new possibilities on his Sussex smallholding. And, as the owner of two rare breed Mangalitsa pigs, he's keen to master charcuterie - the method of preserving meat products. So, he invites neighbour Phil Beale over for a masterclass in curing meat. Phil has honed his craft in charcuterie in Spain, and takes Marcus through several examples of cured meats to show him what could be possible with his Mangalitsa pigs.
Marcus also has crops on his mind. After a recent visit to a small holder who grows wheat, Marcus is keen to give it a go himself, even though it's the wrong time of year. So, after tilling a patch in his no-dig garden, he sows some wheat and hopes it'll grow. For lunch, he rustles up a delicious mushroom and egg dish for him and wife Jane. With several types of mushrooms going into the hot pan, including oyster and portobello, it's a proven family favourite.
Refuelled, Marcus heads off truffle hunting and meets up with Mel and her two highly trained dogs, who've spent years sniffing out the valuable fungi in nearby woods.
Back at the farm, Marcus turns his attention to his herb patch. With autumn approaching, he wants to preserve some of his softer herbs like tarragon and marjoram, so he uses them to make flavoured oils. Keen to find out what others are doing to prepare for the changing season, Marcus returns to Black Rootz, the Afro-Caribbean group dedicated to training young black growers. He meets up with lead grower Richard and discovers that pak choi is a good winter vegetable.

Along the way, they brave sub-zero temperatures, traverse icy routes, encounter deserted gulags and meet the locals who inhabit the frozen wilderness, but despite picking up practical tips for survival, the duo feel they are out of their depth

programme.title: Would I Lie to You? At Christmas
programme.desc: Rob Brydon hosts a festive edition of the comedy panel show from 2016, in which team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack are joined by Richard Osman, Tom Courtenay, Sara Pascoe and Chris Kamara. programme.title: Australia with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The adventurer embarks on a journey across the country, meeting a diverse array of people and encountering exotic wildlife. programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the life and work of people in the polar regions, including the residents of Norilsk in Siberia, the coldest city on Earth. He also discovers how the Danish armed forces maintain their country's claim to Greenland's natural resources by mounting a 2,000-mile dog sled patrol during the winter, and finds out how a research base at the South Pole is able to cope with being cut off from the outside world for six months at a time

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo examines the history of the American rail network, using Appleton's General Guide to the United States and Canada of 1879 to plot his course. He begins on Manhattan Island and travels from Grand Central Terminal to the site of Ground Zero

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his great American trek, following his copy of Appleton's General Guide east from Manhattan to Long Island, and visits Brooklyn to hear the story of the construction of the world's first suspension bridge. Below ground, he investigates New York City's inaugural subway, and the dangers faced by the 'sandhogs' who built it. Progressing along the Long Island Railroad to Queens, Michael takes in an ambitious engineering project and a model town built by an Irish immigrant who became one of America's richest men. Later, he heads to the island's Gold Coast, where he relives the fun of 'the roaring twenties' at Oheka Castle, and concludes this leg of his trip at the Montauk lighthouse on Long Island's eastern-most tip

programme.title: Bangers & Cash

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo crosses the county line from Devon into Somerset, seeing first-hand how willow farmers sought to overcome the challenge from the production of synthetic plastics during the 1930s and hearing how tourism has spread across the region, especially amongst the young. In Bath, Michael visits the former home of a refugee emperor, whose country was invaded by the Italian dictator Mussolini, and in whose name a religious movement began that now flourishes worldwide. Travelling east into Wiltshire, he reaches the largest training area of the British Army, Salisbury Plain

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his travels through the capital in the heart of London's East End. First, Michael explores Hackney Wick, where he hears about The Daily Worker newspaper's origins, before heading to London's West End to hunt down London's oldest surviving Indian restaurant, Veeraswamy. Here, he tries his hand at making chapatis, under the watchful eye of the restaurant's master chef

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the east of England in the inter-war period, starting in Canterbury, Kent, where he treads the boards as he uncovers the political message behind a 1936 play, inspired by the 12th-century murder of Archbishop Thomas a Becket. In Maidstone, he learns of the international origins of the most British symbol of remembrance. Outside Sevenoaks, Michael visits the country home of Winston Churchill, and discovers how the 1930s were wilderness years at Chartwell, as Churchill warned against Nazi appeasement. Once in the capital, he heads to Alexandra Palace, the birthplace of television

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his travels through London in Hampstead, where he learns more about the founder of psychoanalysis, Sigmund Freud, who fled the Austrian capital of Vienna during the Second World War and made his way London. Then, Michael pays a visit to the famous Abbey Road Studios, before making his way to Finsbury and touring the innovative and sculptural housing development, Bevin Court

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: In Lawrence, Kansas, Michael Portillo joins the Jayhawks basketball team in the famous Allen Field house stadium with energetic encouragement from their cheerleaders, before travelling through Tornado Alley to Topeka to meet one of the first storm chasers in America. Driving out on the Great Plains, Michael learns about the Tallgrass Prairie and comes face to face with a herd of wild buffalo

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: The team take on one of their toughest searches for a priceless bracelet lost in a heart-sinking moment. We also attempt to return a recovered phone to its owner, and can crafter Peter conquer a tricky challenge?

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: The detectorist team search for a long-lost family heirloom and the scuba team dive deep in an effort to retrieve a camera full of precious memories. Crafter Steve takes on a metal project and the free divers go into superhuman training

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: The team members dive at an underwater dumping ground to salvage a long-lost motorbike, clean up Helvellyn and remove and recycle dangerous items from all over the Lake District. programme.title: Martin Clunes - Heavy Horsepower
programme.desc: The actor explores the important role of working horses around the world, as he begins training his Clydesdales Ronnie and Bruce to perform duties on his Dorset farm. He meets the Household Cavalry, travels to an Italian vineyard to talk to a man who believes horses are better for soil than tractors, takes part in a traditional equine competition in the French port of Boulogne, and in Belgium, finds out how the animals are used in shrimp fishing

programme.title: David Jason's Great British Inventions
programme.desc: Sir David hears about Sir George Cayley and Percy Pilcher as he looks at the British inventors who played a part in the evolution of flight

programme.title: David Jason's Great British Inventions
programme.desc: Sir David gets behind the controls of a tank as he finds out about the British inventors who gave us some of the most extreme machines on the planet

programme.title: Indian Ocean with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The adventurer begins the final leg of his journey on the northern tip of Sumatra in western Indonesia, near the epicentre of the 2004 Boxing Day tsunami, finding out how the province of Banda Aceh has undergone many changes since the disaster. He also explores the illegal trade in exotic pets in the Indonesian capital of Jakarta, before heading for Australia, the final country on his epic journey. There he visits the unspoilt wilderness of the Kimberley region, meets a crocodile hunter and goes fishing with natives campaigning to stop the construction of a giant gas plant

programme.title: Operation Arctic
programme.desc: Originally broadcast live from the Arctic, this series follows the struggles of polar bears living on this frozen tundra and highlights the impact that environmental changes are having on the bears and the changing world around them. Simon Reeve, Kate Humble and Gordon Buchanan examine the effects of climate change and the struggles these bears now face as the sea ice continues to melt at an alarming rate

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries

programme.title: People's Palaces: The Golden Age of Civic Architecture
programme.desc: Part one of two. Architectural historian Dr Jonathan Foyle explores some of the most impressive Georgian and Victorian buildings in the north of England, beginning with neo-classical constructions. He visits town and concert halls, libraries, schools and galleries in Liverpool, Leeds, Bradford and Manchester to find out how the regular proportion and symmetry of the style was intended to suggest order in chaotically expanding urban environments

programme.title: Britain's Most Fragile Treasure

Composed of 311 panels, it was originally designed to tell the complete biblical history of the world from creation to the Last Judgement, and has been compared to Michelangelo's work at the Sistine Chapel. The historian closely examines the handiwork of its creator John Thornton, revealing intricate details that would not normally be visible, and follows a project to restore the window to its original glory

programme.title: The Medici: Makers of Modern Art

programme.title: Alaska: Earth's Frozen Kingdom

programme.title: The Story of Scottish Art
programme.desc: Lachlan Goudie looks at art in the years between 1880 and the outbreak of the First World War, examining how a new generation of artists captured the spirit of Scotland at the dawn of a modern age. He explores how the Glasgow Boys set out to reflect the lives of ordinary people, in a move away from romanticised highland views, and he discovers how Arthur Melville pushed the boundaries of watercolour painting. He also looks at William McTaggart's landscapes, Charles Rennie Mackintosh's re-working of old-age forms, and JD Fergusson's series of canvases that were simultaneously modern, Continental and Scottish

programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson and Donnie Yen. After years in exile, agent Xander Cage is brought back into action when a potentially lethal space weapon falls into the wrong hands.

programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.
