programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Exhausted from running the hotel, Count Dracula heads off on a sea cruise with the family. Romance beckons in the form of the ship's mysterious captain - but she is hiding a deadly secret that could spell disaster for the monsters.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Steve Buscemi, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Kathleen Turner. With Halloween approaching, three kids attempt to unlock a haunted house's dark secrets before it swallows up unsuspecting trick-or-treaters.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure. SpongeBob the friendly sea sponge sets out from his home town of Bikini Bottom with his starfish friend, Patrick, to reclaim King Neptune's stolen crown.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Alec Baldwin. When a seven-year-old boy discovers that his baby brother is a spy on a secret mission, he joins forces with his suit-wearing, briefcase-carrying sibling to defeat an evil businessman.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure based on the popular TV series. Tommy Pickles is feeling forced out by his new baby brother who just makes too much noise. But when Tommy hatches a plan to return his sibling to the hospital, it leads to some unexpected adventures.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bruce Willis and Chrissie Hynde. Young Tommy Pickles gets the opportunity to meet his nature-documentary hero Sir Nigel Thornberry, after his family vacation goes awry. Stranded on a desert island, the baby and his pals think they're alone, until they encounter the Thornberry clan filming their latest animal epic.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, Chris Rock and David Schwimmer. A zebra called Marty tries to escape his comfortable existence at the Central Park Zoo and return to the wild. Accompanying him, albeit reluctantly, are Alex the lion, a neurotic giraffe and a no-nonsense hippo.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, David Schwimmer and Chris Rock. The escaped animals from Central Park Zoo - Alex the Lion, Melman the Giraffe, Marty the Zebra and Gloria the Hippo - try to fly back from Madagascar but are forced down in the wilds of Africa, where they soon encounter some familiar faces.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Action comedy thriller starring Martin Lawrence and Will Smith as motormouth Miami cops Burnett and Lowrey, who are assigned to bring down a drugs lord and stop the flow of ecstasy into the city. But the operation and the officers' friendship are compromised by Lowrey's relationship with a female agent - who also happens to be Burnett's sister.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's blockbuster adventure, starring Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum and Richard Attenborough. Billionaire tycoon John Hammond has built the ultimate theme park - an island populated by genetically engineered dinosaurs. A group of guests, including Hammond's grandchildren, are invited to preview the attraction, touring the park in remotely controlled cars. But, as a tropical storm gathers, an unscrupulous employee shuts down the elaborate security system, leaving the tour stranded - and mayhem about to break loose.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Superheroes
programme.desc: Never fear, your heroes are here! Join us as we soar into the action-packed worlds of our favourite superheroes, from Superman and Wonder Woman to Hulk and Madame Web.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: Desperate to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards enters a deadly televised competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. Director Edgar Wright's comedy thriller based on the Stephen King story, starring Glen Powell, Lee Pace and Josh Brolin

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson and Donnie Yen. After years in exile, agent Xander Cage is brought back into action when a potentially lethal space weapon falls into the wrong hands.

programme.title: The Legend of Tarzan
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Alexander Skarsgård, Samuel L Jackson and Margot Robbie. Tarzan, now living in England as Lord Greystoke, returns to the Congo to investigate a slave trader.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Fantasy prison drama based on the novel by Stephen King, starring Tom Hanks and featuring Michael Clarke Duncan. Retired warder Paul Edgecomb remembers his time in charge of death-row inmates in a Louisiana penitentiary, and the strange powers of convicted child killer John Coffey.

programme.title: The End of the Affair
programme.desc: A woman gives up an affair to thank God for saving her novelist lover's life during an air raid in Second World War London, but soon begins to question her own faith. Drama based on a Graham Greene novel, starring Deborah Kerr, Van Johnson, Peter Cushing and John Mills

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Peter O'Toole and Katharine Hepburn. In the late 12th century, the omnipotent Henry II gathers his scheming family around him to celebrate Christmas and to choose his successor. As a bitter row develops, Henry's estranged wife Eleanor tries to ensure that one of her ambitious sons inherits the crown.

programme.title: Chaplin
programme.desc: Biographical drama about the early years of Charlie Chaplin's life, starring Robert Downey Jr. Despite a poverty-stricken childhood in London, the young Chaplin learns his craft on the music-hall stage, beginning an acting career that will lead him to international fame and a place among movie legends.

programme.title: Anatomy of a Murder
programme.desc: Classic courtroom drama, starring James Stewart, Lee Remick and Ben Gazzara. When an army lieutenant is held for the killing of a bartender, his defence is "justifiable homicide", on the grounds that the man had viciously assaulted and raped his wife. Paul Biegler is the lawyer hired to defend him.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption
programme.desc: Prison drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Tim Robbins and Morgan Freeman. Maine 1946: sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife and her lover, mild-mannered banker Andy Dufresne tries to adapt to the brutalities of prison life. Over the years, Dufresne's friendship with long-term inmate Red and the discovery that his financial expertise is suddenly in big demand make his ordeal easier to bear.

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Clint Eastwood. San Francisco cop "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned the case of a sniper who has murdered a young girl and threatened further killings if his ransom demand is not met. Dismayed to find himself partnered with a raw recruit, Callahan is soon at odds with his bosses over whether to pay off the killer.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime drama starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Andy Garcia and Robert De Niro. Determined young federal agent Eliot Ness leads a tough team of investigators in a dangerous mission to end Al Capone's violent reign of terror in Prohibition-era Chicago.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. When cutbacks mean the closure of one of the state's two police academies, both institutions become locked in a desperate battle for survival.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jonah Hill and Michael Cera as Seth and Evan, two boys bonded by their lack of popularity. When the pair finally get invited to a party they embark on a quest to procure alcohol in the hope that it will not only lay to rest their geeky reputation but also improve their chances with the opposite sex.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Eddie Murphy and Judge Reinhold. When his boss is murdered, Detroit cop Axel Foley tracks down the suspects to a California theme park called Wonder World. With old friend Billy Rosewood, Foley sets out to crack the case.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young. Eccentric investigator Ace Ventura is hired to discover who is behind the mysterious kidnapping of the Miami Dolphins football team mascot, a dolphin called Snowflake, just a week before the Super Bowl.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. The new mayor of an American city decides to change the rules to allow anyone to join the police force. The decision proves to be a recipe for unadulterated chaos.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. When cutbacks mean the closure of one of the state's two police academies, both institutions become locked in a desperate battle for survival.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Eddie Murphy and Judge Reinhold. When his boss is murdered, Detroit cop Axel Foley tracks down the suspects to a California theme park called Wonder World. With old friend Billy Rosewood, Foley sets out to crack the case.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Musical comedy starring Anna Kendrick and Skylar Astin. New girl Beca doesn't care about being popular on campus, but her singing voice makes her the centre of attention when she signs up to become part of the college's all-female a cappella group, the Barden Bellas. Determined to outshine them are their male counterparts, the Treblemakers.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: Musical comedy starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson. Having been forcibly disbanded for disgracing themselves, a cappella group the Barden Bellas discover a get-out clause - all they have to do is win an international singing competition in Copenhagen.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: Musical comedy starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson. Having graduated from college, the Bellas reunite for one last harmonised hurrah in the form of an overseas tour.

programme.title: National Security
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Martin Lawrence and Steve Zahn. A string of misunderstandings lead to by-the-book cop Hank Rafferty being dismissed from the force and serving a prison sentence for an apparent racial attack on police cadet Earl Montgomery. On his release, Hank is forced to take a job as a lowly security guard, where he is thrown together with an unexpected partner.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Denzel Washington and Pedro Pascal. Now living a peaceful life, former Marine and government agent Robert McCall offers his singular skills pro bono to those in need. However, when his friend is killed under suspicious circumstances, McCall investigates, and uses any means necessary to see justice served.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the hit US TV series, starring Denzel Washington. On the face of it, Robert McCall is just an ordinary guy who works at a DIY store and leads a quiet life. But when McCall befriends a young girl controlled by ruthless Russian gangsters, he's unable to stand idly by and resorts to using skills from his shady former career.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Denzel Washington and Pedro Pascal. Now living a peaceful life, former Marine and government agent Robert McCall offers his singular skills pro bono to those in need. However, when his friend is killed under suspicious circumstances, McCall investigates, and uses any means necessary to see justice served.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Audrey Tautou. When the victim of a ritualised killing is discovered at the Louvre, French cryptographer Sophie Neveu and Harvard professor Robert Langdon are called in to try to identify strange symbols cut into the body. They become embroiled in a deadly conspiracy that has shattering ramifications for Christianity.

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Pillion
programme.desc: Romantic comedy drama starring Harry Melling and Alexander Skarsgård. Colin, a meek 30-something parking inspector who lives with his parents, encounters the tall, handsome and enigmatic Ray. They begin a sexual relationship based around a strict dom/sub power dynamic, but as time goes by the ever-obliging Colin yearns for more tenderness from his leather-clad master.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Black History Month
programme.desc: Celebrate Black history through the power of cinema with unforgettable performances and stories, from Dreamgirls to Sinners and the stars who brought them to life

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on Ronald Harwood's play, directed by Dustin Hoffman and starring Maggie Smith, Tom Courtenay and Billy Connolly. At the Beecham House retirement home for opera singers, the occasion of Verdi's birthday is always marked by a special fundraising concert. But this year the arrival of one particular grande dame throws preparations into chaos as egos clash and old resentments surface.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: Cool Hand Luke
programme.desc: Prison drama starring Paul Newman and George Kennedy. After being sentenced to two years on a chain gang, Luke Jackson is faced with the unrelenting demands of the camp's daily routine. However, his resilience quickly antagonises the gang boss.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Tom Hardy, Mark Rylance and Kenneth Branagh. During the 1940 British evacuation at Dunkirk, three individuals each fight to survive. As young soldier Tommy waits to escape the wartorn beach, a civilian sailor from Weymouth aids in the rescue efforts, while a Spitfire pilot provides air support and gains a singular perspective on the chaos taking place below.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller, the sequel to Pitch Black, starring Vin Diesel. Antihero convict Riddick finds himself on the run from intergalactic bounty hunters, but when he seeks refuge on a strange planet he discovers that the place has been overrun by the all-powerful Necromongers, storm-troopers bent on universal annihilation.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: Black comedy action horror starring Harvey Keitel, George Clooney, Quentin Tarantino and Juliette Lewis. Fleeing the law, two murderous brothers kidnap a priest and his family, driving the priest's Winnebago south for a rendezvous at a lowlife bar in Mexico. Little do they know that the bar's staff and regulars hide a blood-drenched secret.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Tommy Lee Jones and Will Smith. When a New York police officer is recruited by a top-secret agency that monitors alien activity he finds himself in a race against time to save the Earth from destruction.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy sequel starring Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones. When evil alien queen Serleena threatens Earth's safety, former intergalactic secret agent Kay holds the secret to her destruction. However, Kay is now living a civilian life as a post-office worker and his memory of the past has been erased. Can his former partner Jay persuade him to rejoin the sharp-suited Men in Black and save the world?

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Science-fiction comedy starring Will Smith and Josh Brolin. The fight against aliens is taken to a new dimension when Agent J is forced to travel back to 1969 in an effort to prevent his partner's murder by ruthless fugitive Boris the Animal.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
It's Dress Up Day in Fluffytown, and Love Monster is excited to show off his Music Monster superhero costume. It's a superhero character that he has invented, and his superpower is his beatboxing, which makes villains run away.
On his way to the grand stage, where everyone is going to show off their costumes, Love Monster meets Elder Kitten, who is dressed as a mer-kitten. They admire each other's costumes, but when Elder Kitten tries to continue on, Love Monster is still beatboxing in character and doesn't realise that he is blocking his way. Then when Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny arrives dressed as her Caped Carrot supervillain character, the friends have a pretend battle around Elder Kitten, which eventually causes him to trip over the tail of his costume as he tries to get around them. However, Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny are having too much fun to notice and run off, still in character.
They arrive at Bad Idea Puppy's costuming area, where he is making a giant robot-puppy costume with his cousin Good Idea Puppy. Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny are momentarily impressed, but when they resume their hero and villain battle, they accidentally break a lever on the machinery and cause the giant robot costume to break. The battle continues on to the green, where The In-Chicks are just about to finish building the grand stage for the costume show. But when Music Monster and the Caped Carrot take the battle to the unfinished stage, all of their jumping around causes it to shake apart and collapse. Oh no!
When Elder Kitten arrives looking dishevelled, and Bad Idea Puppy and his cousin pull their broken costume in on a cart, Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny finally stop to look around at the problems they have caused. They've ruined the fashion show! Love Monster thinks for a beat and then realises that he could be a real superhero and save the day by helping to fix everything they have broken.
In a superhero montage, Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny work together with the others to fix the broken stage and the giant robot-puppy costume. The rest of the town arrives in their own costumes, and they all have fun showing off their costumes in the Dress Up Day fashion show.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Every time Mush-Mush has tried to surprise his friend with a gift, Chep has always found out what it was. But Chep promises that this time he won’t. / Mushpie loves to sing. Only problem she is terrible at it! But Lilit, who has never heard her sing before, wants to make Mushpie happy and organizes a concert for her to sing. / When Mushpot wishes he could roll back the seasons and relive being a Mushler, our friends get him to hang out doing cool Mushler stuff. / Mush-Mush can’t figure out why his sense foot keeps buzzing like crazy… until an earthquake shakes the forest. Mush-Mush is sure he predicted it!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: When an egg blows down into the village, it is Mush-Mush and friends’ mission to return it to Mush Mountain. / Chep is disappointed Mush-Mush and Lilit are too busy leaf-gliding to play moss-ball with him, so he hangs out with a new weevil friend instead. / When Sushi-Mushi breaks the only spoon he has ever cooked with, he declares his cooking days are over! / Chep wants to return a favour to Mush-Mush, but all Mush-Mush wants is to have a compost pancake on Pancake Day! / Mush-Mush’s favourite frog has had its home taken over by a lizard. Mushpot says not to interfere - nature will balance itself out. / It’s Fool the Forest Day! Mushables pull pranks all over Mushton, and Mush-Mush has an epic one planned.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the joys of photography with the ranger's instant print camera. / The fridge in the cabin gets replaced by a new appliance. / Grizzy watches a demonstration of balloon modelling on TV. He decides to make a balloon poodle to offer the she-bear he's enamored with. / Grizzy needs a nice nap. He can't find a pillow comfortable enough to his taste until he tests the pillow that the Lemmings use as a high-jump mat. / Grizzy is awakened from his nap by the unpleasant ongoing sound of Velcro strips being ripped off. / The she-bear Grizzy is enamored with has lost her favorite flower in an inaccessible spot under a giant boulder. Grizzy tries to lift it: impossible! / The Lemmings try to catch a bat to play rodeo disturbing Grizzy as he plays his favorite game on the ranger's mobile. / The Lemmings have a blast testing every app on the ranger's tablet one by one. Grizzy who is starving sees that the cupboards are bare. / Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the ranger's latest acquisition: a 3D printer that will duplicate anything at all in miniature form.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds and Noah Jupe. More than a year after humanity was attacked by monsters with sensitive hearing, the surviving members of the Abbott family hold the secret to killing the creatures. Followed by a troubled neighbour, hearing-impaired Regan sets out to an island radio tower, hoping to broadcast their discovery - but it isn't only the monsters she has to watch out for.

programme.title: The Blue Caftan
programme.desc: Drama starring Lubna Azabal, Saleh Bakri and Ayoub Missioui. Mina and Halim are loving spouses who run a clothes shop in one of Morocco's oldest medinas. When they take on an apprentice, Youssef, the attraction between the two men becomes increasingly clear.

programme.title: LumoTV: World War II: Unheard Memories
The Nevadan
programme.desc: In order to locate a vast stash of stolen gold, a US Marshal orchestrates the escape of a stagecoach robber, but ends up getting caught in his dealings with a greedy rancher. Western, starring Randolph Scott, Dorothy Malone and Forrest Tucker

programme.title: Send Me No Flowers
programme.desc: A hypochondriac who mistakenly believes he has only a few weeks to live decides not to tell his wife - and also sets about finding her a suitable second husband to succeed him. Romantic comedy, teaming Rock Hudson and Doris Day with Tony Randall, Paul Lynde and Edward Andrews

programme.title: This Gun for Hire
programme.desc: A hired assassin sets out to find the man who paid him with money the police are tracking. He finds an unlikely ally in the girlfriend of one of the detectives on his trail. Thriller based on a novel by Graham Greene, starring Alan Ladd, Veronica Lake, Robert Preston and Laird Cregar

programme.title: Destination Gobi
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Richard Widmark. When their weather station is attacked by the Japanese, an American naval contingent embarks on a gruelling, 800-mile journey across the Gobi Desert.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Halle Berry and Patrick Wilson. When the Moon's orbit starts to change, Earth is threatened with imminent destruction. Two former astronauts and an amateur lunar researcher blast off to try to save the day - but the source of this astronomic anomaly is much tougher to fight than they realise.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: Oscar-winning historical drama directed by and starring Mel Gibson. Scotland at the end of the 13th century: the young William Wallace sees his father and brother killed by the English. Later, when his sworn enemies execute his wife, Wallace leads the clans in the fight for Scottish independence.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc:
Marcus Wareing explores new possibilities for his smallholding in East Sussex. After doing some essential repairs, he gets the digger out as he's keen to start cultivating an area of his land called the Bund. He wants to plant a hedgerow for the wildlife out of tree seedlings, so he drafts in gardening friends Rosanna and Signe to help. They advise him on the best way to plant up the small trees to ensure they grow healthily.
After a short coffee break, Marcus heads over to Mersea Island in Essex to go crabbing with commercial fishermen Andrew and Jonny French. He's used to cooking crabs in his kitchen, but this is the first time he's seen them fished. After a good time at sea, the day's topped off with a chance for Marcus to taste some of the freshly caught and cooked crab.
Back at the farm, Marcus is concerned about his apple orchard. While it has produced a great deal of fruit, he is concerned some of the trees are dying, so he wants to learn how to preserve the remaining ones. He visits Britain's National Fruit Collection at Brogdale Farm in Kent, where he meets Dave, an expert in grafting fruit trees. He discovers that one of the secrets to a successful graft is to have good root stock.
A call from his tenant farmer Stuart takes Marcus back to the farm to help give the sheep a health check to see if they're fit for mating. As a homage to his fishing trip earlier in the day, Marcus makes grilled crab and brown crab meat pate for himself and his wife Jane.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny buys Leonard and Sheldon some Star Trek action figures, but the duo refuse to remove them from the packaging in case their value is diminished. programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Middle

programme.title: The Middle

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: The chef continues his gastronomic road trip from Venice to Istanbul taking in the countries of the former Byzantine Empire - a renowned melting pot of East and West. programme.title: Guy Martin: Arctic Warrior
programme.desc: Guy heads 200 miles above the Arctic Circle to embed with the Royal Marines, the UK's winter warfare experts. Guy is keen to find out if he's tough enough to become a special operations commando, whose job it is to operate in the harshest environments and deter an attack from an increasingly belligerent Russia. Guy embeds at Camp Viking, the Royal Marines' hub of operations in Norway, where the average temperature is minus 20, living with the commandos in their barracks and training alongside them on the annual Cold Weather Warfare Course. Guy is challenged to survive being dunked into a frozen lake and to spend a night with fellow new recruits in the wilderness. Later, there's a chance to drive an all-terrain vehicle using night vision. Guy joins up with Commando Helicopter Force for a live ride on a helicopter gunship. And he explores why exactly Russia values the Arctic so highly and the kind of weaponry they would use in an Arctic conflict

programme.title: Rick Stein: From Venice to Istanbul
programme.desc: The chef continues his gastronomic road trip from Venice to Istanbul taking in the countries of the former Byzantine Empire - a renowned melting pot of East and West. This instalment finds the gastronome in the city of Ravenna, where he discovers Piadinas, a thin Italian flatbread street food dating back to Roman times. He then crosses the Adriatic Sea to Croatia - a first for Rick - and a gets a chance to discover new a wealth of dishes such as pasticada, goat stew with peas and lamb peka

programme.title: Rick Stein: From Venice to Istanbul
programme.desc: The chef continues his journey through Croatia and savours the native oysters of Ston, before crossing the border into Albania, where he is joined by his son Jack and the pair sample local dishes such as chicken jufka and kokoretsi. In his own kitchen on the Greek island of Symi, Rick cooks traditional Albanian dishes, including Lepur Comlek and Tave Kosi

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers explore what Britons ate during wartime and discover how some of the UK's favourite dishes have evolved from rationing. The duo also meet army cooks to find out what troops on the front line eat today, and prepare rabbit stew and carrot cake

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Sarah Millican, Cariad Lloyd and Alice Levine join regular panellist Alan Davies and host Sandi Toksvig for an extended edition of the unconventional quiz, this time focusing on the theme 'Objects and Ornaments'. During the course of the show, the panellists discover where to find an actual UFO and meet the world's best-dressed crab. As ever, correctness and even intelligence go out of the window, as the fiendishly difficult questions lead to points being awarded for the answers its questionmaster finds most interesting, as opposed to correct

programme.title: Guy Martin: Arctic Warrior
programme.desc: Guy heads 200 miles above the Arctic Circle to embed with the Royal Marines, the UK's winter warfare experts. Guy is keen to find out if he's tough enough to become a special operations commando, whose job it is to operate in the harshest environments and deter an attack from an increasingly belligerent Russia. Guy embeds at Camp Viking, the Royal Marines' hub of operations in Norway, where the average temperature is minus 20, living with the commandos in their barracks and training alongside them on the annual Cold Weather Warfare Course. Guy is challenged to survive being dunked into a frozen lake and to spend a night with fellow new recruits in the wilderness. Later, there's a chance to drive an all-terrain vehicle using night vision. Guy joins up with Commando Helicopter Force for a live ride on a helicopter gunship. And he explores why exactly Russia values the Arctic so highly and the kind of weaponry they would use in an Arctic conflict

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo returns to travel by train to more places around the British Isles, beginning by heading to the self-governing Isle of Man - a paradise for rail lovers. His first stop on the Manx Electric Railway is the capital of Douglas, where he reveals the island's parliament the Tynwald is older than Westminster, before the Isle of Man Steam Railway takes him down the east coast to Castletown, from where he heads to the Norse Castle Rusheword

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo begins this leg of his journey at Liverpool's historic waterfront, where he visits the International Slavery Museum at Royal Albert Dock, before heading underground to discover one of the most important and secret rooms of the Second World War, the Royal Navy's Western Approaches Headquarters. His next stop is Crosby on the Merseyside coastline in Sefton, before making his way north to Blackpool, the last stop on this leg of his journey

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his journey across the vast and beautiful Morecambe Bay, where he joins one of the town's last shrimpers to find out how potted shrimp is made, From there, Michael makes his way to Arnside on the Furness Line, where he discovers a magnificently quirky 17th century garden, and across the Arnside viaduct, he reaches Cartmel and its 12th century priory and a Michelin-starred restaurant

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels though Cumbria, setting sail in a small craft on Lake Windermere with a lifelong devotee of Arthur Ransome's children's books Swallows and Amazons. programme.title: The Vicar of Dibley

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: Nick Knowles travels to Holmfirth, West Yorkshire, to meet Richard Ford, a former policeman who suffered a devastating brain-stem stroke in 2012, and is now confined to an electric wheelchair. They are also aiming to renovate the fronts of the houses on the street and put in new utilities, as well as creating a lasting legacy in the form of a support centre, which will help other veterans find homes and jobs

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: Nick Knowles travels to Holmfirth, West Yorkshire, to meet Richard Ford, a former policeman who suffered a devastating brain-stem stroke in 2012, and is now confined to an electric wheelchair. With limited movement and speech, he communicates with wife Jude and his three sons via an iPad, but has little privacy when it comes to using the toilet. Having heard of their plight, the DIY SOS team and designer Charlie Luxton turn up to transform the family's home, planning to give Richard the privacy he needs while also assisting his recovery

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance: Coast and Country

programme.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: The call centre is overwhelmed as a new call comes in every 19 seconds and there's a shortage on available ambulances as crews queue at hospitals to handover patients. programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek, with help from the Mathewsons, drags a mini pickup out of the barn where it's been for 20 years, and a 350cc Douglas Mark V motorbike goes under the hammer.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek is picking up two expertly crafted Batmobile replicas in the home counties and Dave can't control his enthusiasm for a Ford US wartime jeep.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the east of England in the inter-war period, starting in Canterbury, Kent, where he treads the boards as he uncovers the political message behind a 1936 play, inspired by the 12th-century murder of Archbishop Thomas a Becket. In Maidstone, he learns of the international origins of the most British symbol of remembrance. Outside Sevenoaks, Michael visits the country home of Winston Churchill, and discovers how the 1930s were wilderness years at Chartwell, as Churchill warned against Nazi appeasement. Once in the capital, he heads to Alexandra Palace, the birthplace of television

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his travels through London in Hampstead, where he learns more about the founder of psychoanalysis, Sigmund Freud, who fled the Austrian capital of Vienna during the Second World War and made his way London. Then, Michael pays a visit to the famous Abbey Road Studios, before making his way to Finsbury and touring the innovative and sculptural housing development, Bevin Court

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael tracks the River Thames from east to west. Starting in Dagenham, he finishes this leg of his tour at one of London's most iconic buildings, Battersea Power Station, built during the 1930s by Giles Gilbert Scott

The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together, but by the time they reach Cruit Island in Co Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry

programme.title: Young, British and Tradwife

Maryland in the 1840s: born into slavery, Araminta Ross flees her owner before he can sell her on, and is chased for a hundred miles before arriving in Philadelphia. Adopting the name of Harriet Tubman, she goes on to be a pioneering activist, vociferous abolitionist and fearless freedom fighter who returns to the South to free slaves on the secret Underground Railroad.

programme.desc: Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke embark on more cultural city breaks, beginning by heading to the Portuguese capital to see what it has to offer. From a spectacular monument to the maritime globetrotting of Portugal's golden age and the work of a photographer documenting the city's large African population, they discover a complex history of former glories and a darker, slave-trading past

programme.title: The Story of Scottish Art
programme.desc: Lachlan Goudie looks at art in the years between 1880 and the outbreak of the First World War, examining how a new generation of artists captured the spirit of Scotland at the dawn of a modern age. He explores how the Glasgow Boys set out to reflect the lives of ordinary people, in a move away from romanticised highland views, and he discovers how Arthur Melville pushed the boundaries of watercolour painting. He also looks at William McTaggart's landscapes, Charles Rennie Mackintosh's re-working of old-age forms, and JD Fergusson's series of canvases that were simultaneously modern, Continental and Scottish

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: After Charles I's disastrous attempt to impose political and religious uniformity throughout England, Scotland and Ireland, both the Stuart dynasty and its three kingdoms fell into an abyss. In this episode, Dr Clare Jackson reveals how the unprecedented religious violence of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms shaped British political culture and subsequent constitutional crises

programme.title: The Last Spy - Storyville
programme.desc: The story of CIA officer Peter Sichel - a Jewish refugee who fled Nazi Germany before becoming one of the most influential figures in American intelligence. Sichel rose to serve as the CIA's first Station Chief in post-war Berlin and played a pivotal role in some of the defining geopolitical events of the Cold War. Featuring interviews with the man himself before his death in 2024

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: Helen Czerski examines the complexities of colour, including what it is, how it works, and how it has written the story of the planet. In the first edition, she looks for the colours that have made the earth multi-coloured, investigating the essence of sunlight, how vivid blue is formed from sulphur atoms, and why the presence of red ochre is a key sign of life. She also looks at why gold should not even exist on the surface of the planet, and the role of salt and water in shaping planet earth

programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and Ricardo Montalban. In the 23rd century, Admiral James T Kirk is a guest aboard the Enterprise, which is taking part in a training exercise. But the routine voyage becomes a serious mission when his old ship is lured into a deadly trap, placing Kirk and his companions at the mercy of a crazed adversary, the formidable Khan.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring William Shatner and DeForest Kelley. Barely surviving the wrath of Khan, the battle-scarred starship Enterprise limps back to Earth, saved only by the sacrifice of the late Captain Spock. However, the Vulcan's spirit is still with the crew, and back on the artificial Eden of the new Genesis planet his corpse is missing. Against orders, Admiral Kirk decides to lead the search for Spock and bring him home.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. In the 23rd century, Captain Kirk and his intrepid band of space travellers discover a probe in the vicinity of Earth that is trying to contact a humpback whale, a species that is extinct. In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure based on the popular TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The captain and crew of the untested new starship Enterprise travel to the desolate world of Nimbus III after a Vulcan mystic kidnaps a group of Federation diplomats. There, they find themselves caught up in a dangerous quest.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites

programme.title: Braveheart

programme.title: The Mission

Buddy knows that burgers are a winner as they're super-flexible, so he creates the ultimate burger for Alex that's half beef mince and half lentils that his friend can swap for veggie mince and lentils. Using lentils also means you use less meat, which is good for you and the planet - win, win!

In this special episode of Deadly 60, Steve Backshall takes a deep dive into the fate of one of the most extraordinary, and endangered, ecosystems on our planet: coral reefs. They may cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, but they support roughly a quarter of all marine life and are irreplaceable - yet they are in serious trouble.
Steve travels to some of the world's most celebrated reef systems, from the shallows of the Java Sea to the tropical waters of the Maldives. programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
It's the darkest night of the year, so Love Monster plans on getting cosy in bed. He turns the light off but jumps when he hears a hooting noise from outside. He looks out of the window and chuckles when he sees that it's just Nighty-Night Owl on her bedtime walk. Love Monster looks at the dark room apprehensively and turns on his bedroom light, saying maybe he and Monster Teddy can sleep with the light on. He gets into bed but struggles to fall asleep with the bright light above him.
Love Monster gets out of bed and flicks the switch, trying to race back to his bed before it goes off, but he doesn't make it and freezes in the dark. Just then, the wind picks up, causing his light to move, and there's a knocking sound from outside. Love Monster turns the light back on and nervously looks out of his window to see that it's just the wind knocking a branch against his door. Back in bed, Love Monster soon hears a bump from the attic above his bedroom. He cuddles into his bed, hoping that the noise will go away on its own, but it doesn't. He imagines large monster-like feet stomping in his attic. Eventually he decides to go and look in his attic with Monster Teddy.
Love Monster begins to climb up the stairs with a torch, but when he hears the noise again, he imagines the monster again. He knows that it is more than just wind making the noise but can't fall asleep until he knows what's up there. He pushes the attic door open and looks in with his torch. He sees a huge silhouette on the roof and imagines the monster right there. But then he realises that it is just Monster Teddy's silhouette.
Love Monster ventures further into the attic and some boxes move scaring him. But it's getting late, and he has to find out what it is. He summons up all of his courage and investigates further. He moves the boxes to find... three cute grasshoppers cowering in the corner. They're afraid of the very dark night as well! Love Monster invites them downstairs for a sleepover and makes a little bed out of one of the boxes for them, beatboxing them gently to sleep.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey insists Mum and Dad relive their old backpacking days by strapping Bluey, Bingo, Muffin and Socks to their backs and going on an adventure in the garden. But with these cheeky backpacks getting up to mischief, haggling for street food and minicab rides in this strange foreign land is proving a tricky proposition. At the kids prompting, Dad eats too much and needs a bathroom fast! Guidebook in hand. Mum finds their hostel at last but the passports are lost in the bottom of their bags. They only have one option left - shake their giggling bags upside down until everything falls out!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey gives a tour of the animals at her backyard zoo to Lady Gaberdene (Mum) and her adorable toddler, Snowdrop (Bingo), her visitors are especially taken with the big blue Daddy Gorilla. But when Daddy Gorilla scoops up Snowdrop and makes his escape, Zookeeper Bluey has to give chase, while calming an hysterical Lady Gaberdene. With the help of a carefully laid banana trap, Bluey manages to recapture the wild beast, tickling him back to sleep. Seeing how sad Snowdrop is to say goodbye, Zookeeper Bluey bends the rules and arranges one more night-time meetup between the new best friends.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On a car trip to the dump, Dad convinces Bluey that he knows absolutely everything and is the best dad in the world. And when Bluey challenges him, asking difficult questions, Dad's got all the right answers. But when they get to the dump and Bluey sees Dad throwing away some of her old drawings, she realises he may not be right about everything after all. Dad does his best to apologise, explaining that he's actually not perfect and that he was recycling the paper for other kids to use for their drawings. This makes sense to Bluey who accepts his flaws and forgives him.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad is the king of trampoline games and the girls can't get enough. But when it's time for Dad to go to work, Bluey and Bingo can't bear to see him go. Insisting he can't leave without a proper meal, they make him play the breakfast game - bounce-cooking Bingo and Bluey as toast, eggs and even a disgusting smoothie. But all good things must end, and as an emotional Bluey says goodbye, Dad charges her with a job of her own; making up her own new games. She accepts the challenge and with the help of a garden sprinkler transforms the trampoline into a salad spinner for a delighted Bingo and Mum.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Facing an overnight stay in the hospital, Bingo is upset that she can't go home. But her spirits are lifted when Mum shows her a video on her tablet sent by Dad and Bluey. In a ramshackle film shoot of friends, relatives and neighbours, Bluey spins the tale of a young girl on a quest to help heal her poor sick puppy named Bumpy. Her journey leads her across the lands to a wise old wolfhound (played by Aunt Trixie) who opens her eyes to a simple truth - everyone gets sick sometimes and it's just a part of life. As Bumpy is healed with time and love, everyone takes a bow for a delighted Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Playing a game of 'Work', Dad hires cheeky Bluey and frog Bingo for his drainpipe factory. Bluey soon causes trouble, taking every chance to slack off. But rather than be reprimanded, she promotes herself to be Dad's new boss! Bluey proves a stern taskmaster, having Dad lick the floor and even polish the window with his bottom! When Bingo makes Dad break the 'No Dancing' rule, he is fired. Seeing Dad sitting unhappily outside, the ribbiting Bingo encourages him to dance his troubles away and he impresses Mum's passing ballerina, who finds him a new career as a professional dancer.

programme.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
programme.desc: Queen Clarabelle's tea party is disrupted by a dragon. The Sensational Six discover it's their friend Farfus and invite him to join the party.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy drama from the director of The Royal Tenenbaums and Moonrise Kingdom, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson and Cate Blanchett. After his best friend is eaten by a mysterious jaguar shark, famous oceanographer Steve Zissou vows revenge. Joining his crew on the mission are a pregnant journalist and a pilot who claims to be Zissou's long-lost son.

programme.title: Tomorrowland: A World Beyond
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring George Clooney, Hugh Laurie and Britt Robertson. When teenage whizzkid Casey Newton obtains a mysterious pin that gives her visions of a futuristic utopia, her life is suddenly plunged into danger. The only person who can help Casey to survive, find Tomorrowland and save the world is former boy inventor Frank Walker. But he's now a bitter, grizzled recluse who just wants to be left alone.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong

programme.title: Forky Asks A Question
programme.desc: Rex uses the age of dinosaurs as an example to give Forky an understanding of the concept of time.

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Animated musical drama featuring the voices of Chris Sarandon and Catherine O'Hara. Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King, longs to escape the routine of Halloweentown. Through a door in a tree, he stumbles upon Christmastown where he engineers the kidnapping of Santa Claus and wreaks havoc among the inhabitants.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure based on a story by Hans Christian Andersen, featuring the voices of Jodi Benson and René Auberjonois. Plucky mermaid Ariel, daughter of King Triton, is unhappy with her life beneath the waves and makes a deal with devious sea witch Ursula to help her go on land and meet her prince.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: Animated science-fiction adventure based on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel, Treasure Island. When a pirate treasure map falls into the hands of young tearaway Jim Hawkins, he is determined to find the fabled loot. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: Animated fantasy with the voices of Catherine O'Hara, Martin Short and Charlie Tahan. Unable to accept the death of his pet pooch, young science whizz Victor performs an experiment that brings him back to life. But his secret is soon discovered and it's not long before havoc is wreaked all over town.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: Classic animated romantic fantasy from Disney, based on the popular children's story by Charles Perrault. The beautiful Cinderella endures a life of hardship with her malicious sisters and stepmother. But a visit from her fairy godmother could be set to change the downtrodden girl's fortunes.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: Animated fairy tale from Pixar, featuring the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly. Merida, a tomboy Scottish princess, flees the court after her parents insist she should settle down and get married. However, when the errant teenager encounters a witch in the woods and asks her to cast a spell to change the situation, it sets off a chaotic chain of events that only Merida's bravery and archery skills can reverse.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: Animated fantasy featuring the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos, and songs by Randy Newman. In jazz-age New Orleans, a waitress and a playboy prince seek the help of some quirky creatures as they try to break a witch doctor's spell that has turned them into frogs.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: Animated science-fiction adventure based on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel, Treasure Island. When a pirate treasure map falls into the hands of young tearaway Jim Hawkins, he is determined to find the fabled loot. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: Disney animated adventure, featuring the voices of Dane Cook, Stacy Keach and Teri Hatcher. A little crop-dusting plane with a fear of heights dreams of taking part in the prestigious "Wings around the Globe" air race.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Robert Downey Jr, Gwyneth Paltrow and Jeff Bridges. Billionaire playboy Tony Stark is an industrialist and munitions genius who's out in Afghanistan to demonstrate a new missile system, when he and his military escort are attacked by rebels. Though badly injured, Stark is captured and forced to manufacture a weapon. But with the help of a fellow imprisoned scientist, Stark instead builds an armoured suit that will see the tycoon take on the identity of superhero Iron Man.

programme.title: The Maze Runner
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller based on the novel by James Dashner, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Will Poulter. In a post-apocalyptic world, a young man, confined in a community of teenage boys whose memories have been erased, plots his escape.

programme.title: Dating Naked
programme.desc: Chris and Kerri make their final decision over whether they want to pursue a relationship with each other or with one of the other daters

programme.title: Naked Attraction
programme.desc: Married couple Abbie and Charlie join host Anna Richardson and feature as the first picker pair as they search for another woman to join their relationship. Plus 41 year-old actor and glamour puss Chrissie from Leeds is hoping to find husband number four

programme.title: Made in Chelsea
programme.desc: Beks learns the truth from Freddy about the lovebite on his neck. Will Jazz's moment of comfort with Inga affect her relationship with Eve? And Tristan turns to James Taylor for advice

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: The crew receive a record-breaking tip and hit the town to celebrate. But romantic rejections and an ill-advised game turn things sour

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Janine spearheads a pilot programme that brings a librarian to Abbott. But when friction arises with one of the teachers, Janine's relationship with both parties is strained. Meanwhile, Melissa and Jacob deal with some big changes at home

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Hoping to enjoy a true spring break experience, Erica and Barry pay a visit to Pops in Florida, but the jaunt isn't what they expected. Adam tells the truth to his parents when he has a mishap with Beverly's new coat, but he gets a surprising reaction

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Gloria rents a cabin in the mountains in which she hopes she and her family will be able to enjoy a picture-perfect white Christmas. However, when the clan arrives, unhelpful weather and a random eccentric guest conspire to ruin the festive cheer. Meanwhile, Mitch and Cam resolve to make up for their bad carolling experience last year, and Jay has a huge announcement that catches Claire off-guard. Comedy, starring Sofia Vergara

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to Mike & Nellie's Steakhouse in Oakhurst, New Jersey, where owner Mike Farber is mourning his father Nellie, who was also his business partner. Having been called in by the restaurateur's two daughters, Gordon faces the task of getting him to focus on his business, before tackling the bigger problem of rotting decor and a less-than-appealing menu

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Revisited
programme.desc: High-flying groom Kev sits down with his bride Trish and their best friends to remember one of the most turbulent weddings in DTTB history, when a timekeeping issue nearly derailed the whole thing...

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Jonah's claims shake his family, Dee Dee sabotages her audition, and it's full steam ahead for one couple as they plan their wedding

When the business started to fail, the couple decided to splash out on refurbishments to recover their glory days, but their efforts have been futile and now their relationship is at stake

programme.desc: Will's grandmother pays a visit, leaving domestic disharmony in her wake. American comedy, starring Will Smith, James Avery and Virginia Capers

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer, Moe and Lenny go in pursuit of Carl when he skips town with $200,000 in winnings from a lottery ticket he bought with them. programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge is feeling neglected by Homer, and the timing couldn't be worse as their 10th wedding anniversary is fast approaching. But wires get crossed when the miffed housewife stumbles upon a dodgy website for couples bored of their partners, and she ends up chatting to the too-good-to-be-true Ben (voiced by Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane)

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: A huge thunder storm brings wide power outages and the whole family congregates at Jay and Gloria's to use their generator, but Jay has one foot out the door desperately trying to make it to a reunion with some old Navy buddies. programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Married couple Lara and Greg kick off the competition in Lincolnshire with a global menu inspired by their passion for travelling. programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: Oscar-winning historical drama directed by and starring Mel Gibson. Later, when his sworn enemies execute his wife, Wallace leads the clans in the fight for Scottish independence.

programme.title: The Mission
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Robert De Niro and Jeremy Irons. 1750: deep in the South American jungle, Father Gabriel, a Jesuit priest, establishes the outpost mission of San Carlos among the hostile Guarani Indians. But these remote natives are also a valuable source of slaves for the governing Spanish and Portuguese, and soon Father Gabriel finds that his own life is in great danger.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters - sightings, fleeting interactions and aliens taking humans for extended periods.This programme catches up with real people who have experienced alien-life up close

programme.title: Egypt's Unexplained Files
programme.desc: This episode delves into the brainpower behind ancient Egypt's revolutionary breakthroughs in every field, from medicine to engineering. Examining their colossal cities, their artistic masterpieces and their surgical procedures, we reveal that this is a culture whose genius has truly shaped our modern world.

programme.title: Ancient Murders Unearthed
programme.desc: The stories of infamous and little-known murders and the mysteries still surrounding them. Today's modern psychological knowledge is used hand-in-hand with new forensic developments to understand the last actions of ancient victims and theorise on the motives of their killers. Louisiana homicide detective Rod Demery and geneticist, archaeologist and forensics expert Professor Turi King begin by looking at the so-called Rosemarkie Man, the remains of a person brutally murdered more than 1,400 years ago

programme.title: Truthseekers
programme.desc: The mystery of Atlantis, the 'lost' island subcontinent often idealised as an advanced, utopian society holding wisdom that could bring world peace. The notion has captivated dreamers, occultists and New Agers for generations

programme.title: Bone Detectives: Britain's Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Tori Herridge and a team of scientists attempt to piece together the lives behind discovered bones, and find out what happened to these people and how they died. programme.title: Alien Files: Unsealed

programme.title: Rick Stein: From Venice to Istanbul

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities
programme.desc: David Attenborough highlights the curiosities that have led to accusations of forgery, but have ultimately helped assist the rethinking of evolution. In 1945, at a New York VJ Day ball, jazz saxophonist Jimmy Doyle engineers a meeting with singer Francine Evans with whom he auditions for the Palm Club's big band the following day. They are hired as a duo and begin a volatile relationship that develops against a background of changing musical trends.

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: Helen Czerski examines the complexities of colour, including what it is, how it works, and how it has written the story of the planet. In the first edition, she looks for the colours that have made the earth multi-coloured, investigating the essence of sunlight, how vivid blue is formed from sulphur atoms, and why the presence of red ochre is a key sign of life. She also looks at why gold should not even exist on the surface of the planet, and the role of salt and water in shaping planet earth

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: Visits to historic places of work, including one of Britain's oldest dockyards in Chatham Kent, and Armley Mill in Leeds. programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: Richard Holmes traces the events of the Battle of the Somme on July 1, 1916, the blackest episode in British military history, when 57,000 Allied soldiers were killed or wounded in a matter of hours

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: After Charles I's disastrous attempt to impose political and religious uniformity throughout England, Scotland and Ireland, both the Stuart dynasty and its three kingdoms fell into an abyss. programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: Military historian Richard Holmes recounts the German invasion of France in 1940, when Allied forces attempted to halt the Panzer divisions' relentless advance. Nazi commanders bypassed the fortified Maginot line by invading via Belgium, sweeping aside a makeshift opposition comprising over-age reservists, a French North African cavalry unit and outmoded British tanks. The Allies eventually launched a counter-attack near Arras - but by then it was too late

programme.title: Chauvet: Humanity's First Great Masterpiece
programme.desc: Following a 30-year archaeological, geological and artistic adventure as scientists endeavour to understand and conserve the art of the Chauvet cave. Hidden deep inside France's Gorges de l'Ardèche, the cave was revealed to the modern world for the very first time in 1994. It has over 1,000 paintings adorning its walls and scientists immediately recognised the importance of the discovery

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox examines the remotest part of the solar system, a place that the most mysterious planets - Uranus, Neptune and dwarf planet Pluto - call home. Barely visible to the naked eye, Uranus was once thought to be the furthest planet from the Sun, before Neptune was discovered. Thanks to a rare alignment of the planets in 1976, Voyager 2 was sent for mankind's only flyby of these ice worlds. Even at such cold temperatures, great storms whip around these frozen worlds, which are home to spectacular moons and intricate ring systems. Then in 2015, Nasa's New Horizons probe pushed the frontier even further into space with its extraordinary passage to the dwarf planet Pluto
