programme.desc: Paul Murton tours Outer Orkney, beginning at North Ronaldsay, which may be the most northerly of the Orkneys but turns out to be surprisingly easy to get to. Paul then hops across to Papa Stronsay, which is now populated by an order of monks who have chosen to make this isolated island their home, and ends on the island of Stroma in the Pentland Firth, a previously inhabited island that was abandoned in the 1950s. One of the last people to live there joins Paul to recall when it was still a thriving community

programme.desc: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch coven with co-workers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin challenges their sisterhood, forcing the trio to confront their inner darkness. As tensions rise and the coven's secrets threaten to spill, they must face their fears or all meet a violent end. Comedy horror, starring Lili Reinhart

programme.title: Couples Weekend
programme.desc: Four adults navigate deception and desire when a fallen tree on New Year's Eve triggers a chain of events that challenges their relationships and the lies they tell themselves and each other. Writer/director Nora Kirkpatrick's comedy drama, starring Alexandra Daddario and Daveed Diggs

programme.title: Finnegan's Foursome
programme.desc: Two rival brothers and their adult children travel to Ireland to scatter their father's ashes, turning clashing egos and comic mishaps into an unexpected week of family bonding. Comedy drama written, directed by and starring Edward Burns, with Brian d'Arcy James and Erica Hernandez

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: My Christmas Cowboy
programme.desc: After a humiliating college audition, Meg builds a career producing news in Texas. Former crush Billy, now a disgraced Hollywood host, returns home for Christmas. When Meg's injured father asks Billy to host the ranch's Reindeer Roundup, riding lessons rekindle resentment and affection, helping them discover confidence and possibly love. Romantic drama, starring Amy Acker and Luke Macfarlane

programme.title: The Pout-Pout Fish
programme.desc: A pouty fish and an energetic sea dragon embark on an underwater quest to find a legendary fish who can save their homes. Animated adventure, with the voices of Grant Denyer, Nadine Bates and Nick Offerman

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.title: The End of Oak Street
programme.desc: After an American street is ripped from suburbia and transported somewhere unknown, the Platt family fight for survival. Writer/director David Robert Mitchell's fantasy adventure, starring Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Reminders of Him
programme.desc: Kenna Rowan emerges from a seven-year prison sentence, and returns to the hometown where she was held legally responsible for the death of her boyfriend, Scotty Landry. She is grimly resolved to confront ghosts of the past so she can finally meet the daughter she was forced to give up. Drama, starring Maika Monroe

programme.title: Splitsville
programme.desc: When Ashley asks husband Carey for a divorce, he turns to friends Julie and Paul for support. Carey is stunned to discover their secret to happiness is an open marriage. However, when Carey and Julie cross a line, the arrangement unleashes jealousy and chaos, forcing both couples to confront what they want from love and commitment. Romantic comedy, starring Dakota Johnson, Adria Arjona, and Michael Angelo Covino, who also co-wrote and directed

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: The Long Kiss Goodnight
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Geena Davis and Samuel L Jackson. A housewife with amnesia who hires a private detective to find out about her past life discovers that she was once a hitwoman for the CIA, and that someone wants her dead.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Black comedy horror starring Zach Galligan and Phoebe Cates. In a small American town, kindly inventor Rand Peltzer brings home a cute little animal called a mogwai for his son Billy, with three rules for its upkeep: never get the mogwai wet, expose him to light or feed him after midnight. Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: Christmas with the Kranks
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis. After their daughter goes to Peru to serve with the Peace Corps, Luther and Nora Krank face their first Christmas alone. Miserable at the prospect, they decide to completely forget yuletide and go on a Caribbean cruise. But their change of plan doesn't go smoothly.

programme.title: White Christmas
programme.desc: Musical starring Bing Crosby and Danny Kaye. Old army buddies Phil Davis and Bob Wallace travel with the glamorous Haynes sisters to the Columbia Inn in Vermont. There, Phil and Bob are reunited with their old commanding officer, General Waverly, who is now struggling to keep the hotel going. The visitors decide there's only one answer - to put on a show.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: Miserly Ebenezer Scrooge loathes the Christmas season until, late one night, he is visited by a series of ghosts who intend to change his attitude by showing him visions of his past, his present and the fate that will await him if he continues with his cold-hearted behaviour. Adaptation of Dickens' classic tale, with Patrick Stewart, Richard E Grant, Joel Grey, Ian McNeice, Saskia Reeves, Tim Potter and Desmond Barrit

programme.title: My Christmas Cowboy

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: Animated fantasy based on the book by Dr Seuss, featuring the voice of Benedict Cumberbatch. The embittered, mountain-dwelling Grinch plots to ruin the festive season for the cheery citizens of Whoville. That is until he finds his spirits unexpectedly lifted by a young girl and her family.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: Nativity!
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Freeman. Despite being traumatised by a bad review years earlier, primary school teacher Paul Maddens is tasked with directing the annual Nativity play. Taunted by a teacher from a rival school, Paul foolishly promises that an old flame, now a Hollywood producer, is coming to see his production.

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Scrooged
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy, starring Bill Murray, Karen Allen and featuring Robert Mitchum. Frank Cross, the youngest network president in television history, is a man who hates Christmas and plans to exploit the holidays to attract as many viewers as possible, no matter what it takes. However, Frank is about to be visited by three unconventional ghosts who will go to any lengths to make him change his mean-spirited ways.

programme.title: Love Actually
programme.desc: Ensemble romantic comedy featuring Hugh Grant, Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Keira Knightley and Bill Nighy. In London, during the weeks leading up to Christmas, people from various walks of life - among them adult film performers, a washed-up rock star and the British Prime Minister - suffer the emotional highs and lows of being in love.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson and Donnie Yen. After years in exile, agent Xander Cage is brought back into action when a potentially lethal space weapon falls into the wrong hands.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: Smallfoot
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Channing Tatum and James Corden. Migo lives with his fellow yetis in the Himalayas, where they have no contact with the outside world. When he meets and befriends a human wildlife expert, Migo realises he has some harsh truths to learn about the reason for the yetis' isolation.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez. Count Dracula is the gracious host at his daughter's 118th birthday party, which he's throwing at his own "five stake" resort for monsters. But he's less welcoming of a mortal backpacker who takes a shine to his precious girl.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Things have settled down at Dracula's hotel now that humans are allowed to stay. However, the Count can't help but worry that his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis isn't proving to be a chip off the old vampire block. So while Johnny and Mavis are away, Drac and his monster buddies decide to put Dennis through his paces.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Exhausted from running the hotel, Count Dracula heads off on a sea cruise with the family. Romance beckons in the form of the ship's mysterious captain - but she is hiding a deadly secret that could spell disaster for the monsters.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Emma Thompson and Colin Firth. Victorian England: following their mother's death, the seven Brown children have become completely uncontrollable. Seventeen nannies have come and gone and their poor father is at his wits' end. But then salvation appears in the form of the legendary Nanny McPhee, a stern and comically ugly woman who mysteriously appears on their doorstep armed with a magic stick.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee and the Big Bang
programme.desc: Period fantasy adventure starring Emma Thompson and Maggie Gyllenhaal. With her husband away at war and the potential loss of her farm to worry about, Mrs Green is struggling to keep order among her three children and their evacuee cousins. But then magical Nanny McPhee arrives to dish out her special kind of discipline.

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Monster horror starring Matthew Broderick and Jean Reno. When a Japanese vessel is sunk in the South Pacific and enormous footprints are discovered in Panama, a team of scientists is brought in to investigate. But radiation expert Niko Tatopoulos has his own theory - nuclear bomb tests have mutated a lizard to gigantic proportions and Manhattan is now under threat.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Superheroes
programme.desc: Never fear, your heroes are here! Join us as we soar into the action-packed worlds of our favourite superheroes, from Superman and Wonder Woman to Hulk and Madame Web.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Dwayne Johnson and Jason Statham. When it becomes apparent that someone out for revenge is picking off members of his crew one by one, Dominic Toretto decides the gang should get back together. But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Vin Diesel, Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Charlize Theron. The whole team have dispersed to live quieter lives. But with Dom seemingly seduced into a life of techno terrorism by the mysterious Cipher, it looks like the opportunity to put their feet up will have to wait.

programme.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Idris Elba. Bickering agents Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are paired up to track down a deadly supervirus that has been stolen by terrorist Brixton Lore. But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Rebirth
programme.desc: Profit-hungry pharmaceutical representative Martin Krebs contracts covert operations specialist Zora Bennett to assemble a crack team to infiltrate a forbidden island and collect the DNA of three key dinosaur species. Fantasy adventure, starring Scarlett Johansson, Mahershala Ali and Jonathan Bailey

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Andrew Garfield and Emma Stone. Peter Parker's parents disappeared when he was young, and he has been raised by his uncle and aunt. But he is socially awkward and bullied at high school. When a bite from a genetically modified spider gives Peter extraordinary powers, he is not only able to assert himself at school, but also resolves to use them to fight evil.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Jamie Foxx. Peter Parker just wants to hang out with his girlfriend but is burdened with having to save New York from a new electrically-charged enemy. Also lurking in the shadows is his increasingly embittered and volatile old friend Harry Osborn.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

On the way home, the rental car's GPS asks him if he would like to embark on a big bold beautiful journey. programme.desc: Until six months ago, the Banken family were homeless. Juliana and her three children, Alex, Felicity and James, spent 15 months living in a tent in the forest, with no shower or toilet facilities. To get them through the tough times, Juliana promised her children that if they ever got a house with a garden, they could get a dog. Now that day has arrived. Three-month-old cute kelpie cross Jeffords, who's been in foster care, is ready to find his forever home. It's love at first sight for everyone, but will Jeffords' destructive puppy behaviour be too much for the family to handle? Elsewhere, lovebirds Meg and Matt are instantly smitten with Travis the staffy, but his lack of interest towards Matt leaves them questioning whether the feeling's mutual. Combined, these make molecules, which in turn join to make cells, the fabric that makes up every living thing.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
Love Monster goes about his morning routine of making breakfast, but nothing goes right for him - he stubs his toe, spills his cereal, runs out of milk and his toaster malfunctions. On the radio, Elder Kitten announces that today is Super-Fun Day, a day where Fluffytowners are encouraged to have their most-super-fun-day ever. Love Monster grumbles to himself that Super-Fun Day is not super-fun so far.
He heads out to see Book Cub, and along the way he sees Bad Idea Puppy having super-fun on his skateboard. Love Monster arrives at Book Cub's van and tells her that his super-fun day hasn't even been a little bit fun yet, and she suggests that he practices yoga with her. Love Monster gives it a go but falls over. Not fun. Book Cub gives Love Monster her fun magnet - a device that points Love Monster in the direction of fun. The fun magnet leads Love Monster to the roller disco, where Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny is having super-fun and encourages him to try it. Love Monster joins in and has fun to start with but soon loses control and falls over again.
Next, the fun magnet leads him to Bad Idea Puppy, who is having super-fun racing his box car down a hill and invites Love Monster to join him in a race. Love Monster agrees and it looks like he's beginning to have super-fun, but then his box car falls apart. This wasn't super-fun either! Finally, the fun magnet leads Love Monster to the empty bouncy castle. Love Monster is confused and looks around - this doesn't look like super-fun because no one else is here. Just then, Book Cub, Bad Idea Puppy and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny arrive.
Book Cub asks him how the fun-magnet is working, and Love Monster sighs that it's not going very well. His friends are confused as they all thought Love Monster was having fun with them. Love Monster says he was having fun, but nothing seemed super-fun because he was thinking of all the things that went wrong. That makes him realise that he could have been thinking about all the things that went right - like hanging out with his friends all day! Book Cub suggests that they all go on the bouncy castle together, and Love Monster agrees because every day is super-fun with his friends!

Not just a tech history lesson but an anarchic thriller, this is the story of a technology whose power sits not in the algorithms, but with the handful of people who control them

programme.desc: In the west of Scotland, a loosely themed Italian menu, a beef stroganoff that fails to live up to its billing, and a Scottish and Indian fusion menu that leaves the guests high and dry

programme.desc: Phil Spencer and Kirstie Allsopp help clothing designer Lexie and IT consultant Ed from Nottingham decide whether to renovate their four-bed one-bathroom house or sell it and move elsewhere. programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: The King of Queens

programme.title: The King of Queens

programme.desc: Debra and Ray are taken aback to realise they are much nicer to strangers than to each other, and decide to show a little more mutual consideration in future - but their resolve soon crumbles. American comedy, guest starring Kevin James as Doug Heffernan, his character in The King of Queens

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Robert begins taking Debra out swing dancing, but Ray feels they are becoming too close and schemes to break up their partnership. Comedy, starring Ray Romano

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Double-length episode. Donny issues a lawsuit against Daphne for jilting him at the altar, and Mel plots revenge against Niles after he abandoned his marriage to her. Comedy, starring David Hyde Pierce, Jane Leeves and Saul Rubinek

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: A lovestruck Frasier persuades Martin to look round a retirement home because he wants to meet the establishment's attractive manager. Comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer and John Mahoney

programme.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits M'Dears Bakery and Bistro, a struggling restaurant in Los Angeles that specialises in Southern cuisine with a Californian twist and freshly baked goods. He and his team have just 24 hours to redecorate the premises, changing the dated dining area into a cosy and tasteful soul food destination. They also introduce a revamped menu, working around the clock with the staff of M'Dears, who must learn how to prepare the new dishes efficiently. The customers are asked to return the next day, dine in the updated restaurant and critique their experience

programme.title: Renovation Nation
programme.desc: Rosi and Antony attempt to transport 300 tonnes of salvaged items from their old home to their Scottish farmhouse. In Cornwall, interior designer Anouska and Greig create a basement cinema room and in Shropshire, Catherine goes on a journey to meet a very special former resident

programme.title: Escape to Florida
programme.desc: Seán gets into deep water with his Apollo Beach fishing charter sideline. Charmaine runs a multimillion-pound business from her Miami bedroom while homeschooling her daughter, and outside Orlando, Gary and Maria are expecting more grandchildren

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Konnie Huq in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against words and numbers

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Ben Hillman house-hunts with retired couple Clare and Alan around the central Algarve region of Portugal. The couple are dreaming of a three-bedroom holiday home where they can spend plenty of time with their daughter, her fiancé and their two young grandchildren. With a budget of £290,000, can Ben rise to the challenge?

programme.title: Help! We Bought a Village
programme.desc: Francesca and Carl have committed to bringing two abandoned Italian hilltop villages back to life, while tricky climate conditions lead to a worrying olive harvest at Lucie and Jerry's borgo. Kevin and Anna hope the opening of their new French pub will bring back the community spirit to a lost rural estate

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Karen and Adrian stake a claim for being the busiest B&Bers in Four in a Bed history at The Barn in North Yorkshire - a B&B, village shop and post office all rolled into one. But one guest reckons that such a big to-do list means the hosts haven't paid enough attention to his poached eggs at breakfast

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Former-beauty-queen-turned-property-developer Joey hosts the third night in north Wales. She's hoping her pageant-themed evening and glam food will wow her guests and win her another crown and the £1,000 prize! Piers gets stuck into the food, but Jake is left wanting more, especially steak. Laura's dating history confuses everyone and the banter between Joey and Saffron bubbles over, which divides the group. Will a catwalk competition help Joey win?

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Retired couple Wendy and Andrew dream of owning a holiday home in southern Spain, and have chosen their favourite location of Andalucía to base their search. Craig Rowe shows them five options for their maximum budget of £217,000, from a traditional place that has them beaming to a townhouse they've already viewed

programme.title: Channel 4 News
programme.desc: Including sport and weather

programme.title: Rory Peck Awards
programme.desc: Profiles of the finalists in this year's Rory Peck Awards, which celebrates freelance film-makers who bring the world's stories to the screen. Lebanese journalist Janay Boulos and Syrian director Abd Alkader Habak collaborate remotely from thousands of miles apart. With both their homelands ravaged by war, what threatens to tear them apart ultimately brings them closer together

programme.title: Location, Location, Location
programme.desc: Phil Spencer catches up with two previous couples to see how their lives have changed since. In 2016, Cara and Ben realised that in order to have the space they wanted they'd need to move out of London, prompting a search of Essex. There's also a revisit to Steve and Sally, who wanted to relocate to the Warwickshire countryside in 2014. They had a long wish list for their ideal property, plus the added pressure of finding a home before the birth of their first child

programme.title: Hunting Alice Bell
programme.desc: As public attention intensifies, the women find themselves living under an increasingly unforgiving spotlight. As they head to a women's conference in Dublin, suspicion begins to turn inwards and a stark message from serial killer Dr Jason Nash himself threatens to expose it all. Mystery thriller, starring Alexandra Roach, Amanda Abbington, Simon Pegg and Ralf Little

programme.title: First Dates

Father and son Brian and Thomas go on a double date, proving whether having an older relative as a wingman is a help or a hindrance. Make-up influencer Bradley hides behind his jokey online persona while struggling to open up to Joseph - his tall, dark and handsome date, and disco dancing widower Mark is looking for more than just a dance partner as he turns 60

programme.title: The More the Merrier

programme.title: Sugarplummed

Romantic fantasy, starring Bethany Joy Lenz, Kristoffer Polaha and Robert Picardo

programme.title: Bluey

Mistakenly identified as Earth's leader, Elio must form new bonds with eccentric alien life-forms, navigate a crisis of intergalactic proportions, and somehow discover who and where he is truly meant to be.

There they encounter the evil Captain Hook and the jealous fairy Tinker Bell.

When a pirate treasure map falls into the hands of young tearaway Jim Hawkins, he is determined to find the fabled loot. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog

Can Belle learn to love the beast and break the spell?

programme.title: Inspector Gadget

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

But when he lost his father as well, John became overwhelmed by the responsibility of running both establishments and his livelihood is at risk

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: American Pickers

programme.desc: Until six months ago, the Banken family were homeless. To get them through the tough times, Juliana promised her children that if they ever got a house with a garden, they could get a dog. Now that day has arrived. It's love at first sight for everyone, but will Jeffords' destructive puppy behaviour be too much for the family to handle? Elsewhere, lovebirds Meg and Matt are instantly smitten with Travis the staffy, but his lack of interest towards Matt leaves them questioning whether the feeling's mutual. programme.title: Highland Cops

programme.title: Rick Stein: From Venice to Istanbul
programme.desc: The chef's gastronomic road trip from Venice to Istanbul through the countries of the former Byzantine Empire is nearing its end as he leaves southern Greece for the shores of western Turkey. On the Cesme Peninsula Rick enjoys creamy Armola cheese matured in goat skins, Urla's famous red wine and the ultimate Turkish breakfast. He also cooks the country's iconic dish sultan's delight - a mouth-watering lamb stew on a bed of aubergine puree

programme.title: Rick Stein: From Venice to Istanbul
programme.desc: The chef's gastronomic road trip reaches a conclusion as he arrives in Istanbul, just in time for the bluefish season, which allows him the chance to enjoy a fishing expedition on the Bosphorus, one of the world's most strategic waterways, which divides the city into two continents. Rick also cooks two much-loved local dishes - lavish kofte kebabs with pistachios, and kapuska, a hearty traditional Turkish cuisine stew from the Black Sea region, whose name is derived from the Russian word for cabbage

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British

programme.desc: Robert and Amy exchange vows in a wedding ceremony that has the Barone family tradition written all over it

programme.desc: Hilda and Zelda are inspired by Sabrina's service to the community and agree to let one of Salem's old cronies stay with them

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Joey becomes convinced Phoebe is pregnant and proposes to her so she will not have to be a single mother - but Monica quickly tells him the truth. Meanwhile, Chandler and Ross misplace the disposable cameras used during the wedding

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Rachel reveals the identity of the father of her baby, while Chandler and Monica go on their honeymoon, but are constantly upstaged by another couple who get preferential treatment wherever they go

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Phoebe finds herself attracted to flighty twin sister Ursula's fiance as the gang has fun at Monica's Halloween party. The Bings dress up as Catwoman and a pink bunny, and Rachel tries to kick-start her maternal instincts with a host of trick-or-treaters. Guest starring Sean Penn

programme.desc: Rachel finally tells her father she is pregnant, prompting him to confront Ross - who is just snuggling up to new girlfriend Mona. Monica feels guilty about denying Chandler a stripper on his stag night so she books one to make amends - but he gets a lot more than he bargained for

programme.desc: Phoebe discovers Ben goes to school with Sting's son and immediately sets about trying to wangle free concert tickets. programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: Monica prepares a Valentine's Day surprise for Chandler, while Ross has difficulty telling girlfriend Mona that Rachel has moved in. Phoebe tries to lift Joey's spirits by bringing him a remarkably cheerful dog. Starring Courteney Cox

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two

programme.title: The Emerald Isles
programme.desc: Ardal O'Hanlon starts the last leg of his journey on Garnish Island, home to lush gardens and the rare white-tailed eagle. Continuing by sea to Sherkin Island, Ardal hears about its pirate past from a historian and a resident artist reveals its current status as a painters' paradise. His final stop is Cape Clear, Ireland's southernmost island, where he is taken on a tour in one of the island's electric buses

programme.title: Barra on the Foyle

In Aviemore, a rock festival erupts into violence, while campers in Fort William take a wrong turn and officers are on the hunt for a suspect after a woman is attacked in an Inverness cemetery

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal reunite for the first time in decades, revisiting the rivalries and rows that shaped their careers. Each serves an iconic dish for the others to taste as they reflect on British dining's transformation and whether wounds can heal-or competition defines them

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk interrogates some of the world's foremost filmmakers and critics, discovers an age of screen icons from Marilyn Monroe to Wayne John, and learns how Hollywood movies changed as American social values relaxed. She also gives her verdict on classics like Jaws, Taxi Driver, and Citizen Ken - very much the 'Citizen Kane' of films about people called Ken. Comedy, starring Diane Morgan

programme.title: Newsnight

programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: Lee and Sarah keep a careful watch as people spill out of the pubs and clubs of Portadown, where Stephen is harangued by a man, but sends the trouble-maker packing. Back in Belfast, Jade, Tom, Perri and Adam spot an argument outside shops, where young people say their money has been stolen by a woman

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Greta Lee and Teo Yoo. Young South Korean friends Nora and Hae Sung lose touch when Nora's family moves to Canada. Years later, Nora is living in New York and gets in contact with Hae Sung over the internet. Video calls become an important part of their lives, until communication is again lost. Twelve years on, Hae Sung takes a trip to the States and the pair are reunited, but will their childhood connection still be strong?

programme.desc: The former steeplejack explores the achievements of Britain's civil engineering pioneers, visiting the Channel Tunnel, Humber Bridge and Pontcysyllte Aqueduct. He also has a go at legging a narrowboat through a canal tunnel in Dudley in the West Midlands

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox examines the remotest part of the solar system, a place that the most mysterious planets - Uranus, Neptune and dwarf planet Pluto - call home. Barely visible to the naked eye, Uranus was once thought to be the furthest planet from the Sun, before Neptune was discovered. Thanks to a rare alignment of the planets in 1976, Voyager 2 was sent for mankind's only flyby of these ice worlds. Even at such cold temperatures, great storms whip around these frozen worlds, which are home to spectacular moons and intricate ring systems. Then in 2015, Nasa's New Horizons probe pushed the frontier even further into space with its extraordinary passage to the dwarf planet Pluto

programme.title: Alaska: Earth's Frozen Kingdom
programme.desc: To survive the bone-chilling cold, deadly blizzards and darkness of the eight months of an Alaskan winter takes courage, cunning and remarkable endurance. This episode tells the stories of how the tough and resourceful animal and human inhabitants of the windswept mountain peaks, icy tundra and snowbound forests face up to the challenges of the season

programme.title: War Walks

However, the battle - later described as the 'death ride of the armoured divisions' - succeeded in distracting enemy forces from a simultaneous American push

programme.title: Homestead Rescue: Raney Ranch

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters

programme.desc: Comedy mystery thriller starring Anna Kendrick and Blake Lively. Vlogger and author Stephanie Smothers is promoting her new book when her murderous former friend Emily turns up to the signing. Released from prison pending appeal, Emily wants Stephanie to be the maid of honour at her wedding in Capri. However, as the guests arrive in Italy, bodies start to pile up.

programme.title: My Mate's a Bad Date
programme.desc:
Cardiff-based hopeless romantic Lewis just can't help hearing wedding bells and talking through future life plans on date one, but that's not the only obstacle to him getting a second date. If he's not ranting about his exes, he's zoning out mid-conversation, leaving his dates lost for words and never calling them again.
Tired of listening to yet another of his first-date failures, Lewis's best mate Megan thinks it's time for an intervention, so she enlists the help one of Gen Z's sassiest sex and relationships experts, Oloni, to drop some hard home truths on 20-year-old Lewis to try to end the bad habits that send his dates running for the hills.
Oloni gives Lewis a reality check as his friends and exes tell it how it is via video feedback, explaining where it's all going wrong. Oloni and Megan watch on as Lewis goes on a series of first dates that will challenge him to rethink his dating behaviour and become a better dater. Can Lewis ditch the wedding planning, stop raking up stories about his exes and focus on the conversation long enough to prove he can be a good date?

Animated adventure, with the voices of Colm Feore, Harland Williams, Paul Van Dyck and Millie Davis

His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.desc: Comedy starring John Candy and Macaulay Culkin. Buck Russell is a fun-loving bachelor without a care in the world. He's also the world's greatest slob. So when he has to look after his sharp young nephew and nieces while their parents are away, anything can - and will - happen.

At Christmas, three children are told the story of Nikolas, a young Finnish boy searching for a magical elf kingdom. Along for the ride are a talking mouse and a friendly reindeer, as Nikolas embarks on a quest that will see his name go down in history.

programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Reese Witherspoon and Vince Vaughn. Social rejection soon follows, leading his "happy feet" to be blamed for a colony-threatening fish famine. Determined to prove his worth, Mumble heads off on a perilous journey to discover the truth about what has happened to the fish stocks.

programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller in which Vin Diesel and Paul Walker, the stars of the first film in the street-racing franchise, team up again. Criminal Dominic Toretto returns to LA to avenge the murder of one of his friends by a drug kingpin, bringing him face to face with an old rival - FBI agent Brian O'Conner.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Sports drama starring Tom Cruise, Robert Duvall and Nicole Kidman. Cocky racing driver Cole Trickle is revved up to take the stock-car circuit by storm, but his aggressive driving style soon lands him in hospital. There he meets Dr Claire Lewicki, who gives the young driver more than racing to think about.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Book Adaptations
programme.desc: From page to screen, the Cinema List celebrates book adaptations. Featuring Wuthering Heights starring Margot Robbie and Bridget Jones's Diary, see these stories on film

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Doug McClure. Loner Charlie Anderson keeps his family out of the Civil War, even though there is fighting a few miles from his Virginia farm. But when his new son-in-law joins the Confederate army and his youngest son is captured by Federal troops, Charlie finds he can no longer ignore the conflict.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Action comedy thriller starring Martin Lawrence and Will Smith. Two chalk-and-cheese Miami drugs squad detectives - one a wise-cracking, Porsche-driving ladies' man, the other married with a family - are assigned to track down a missing $100-million shipment of heroin.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford and Karen Allen. Indiana Jones's outrageous exploits take him around the world in search of the legendary Ark of the Covenant, a religious artefact of unspeakable power wanted by the Nazis. With the help of an old flame, Indy takes on his enemies in a terrifying and death-defying battle to the finish.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Fantasy horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell and Embeth Davidtz. The second sequel to the original Evil Dead finds Ash back in medieval times and desperate to return to the present. But to do so, it means having to take up arms against an army of familiar old foes.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy featuring the music of Abba, and starring Meryl Streep, Colin Firth and Pierce Brosnan. On an idyllic Greek island, young Sophie Sheridan prepares to marry the man of her dreams. But a problem looks set to blight the big day as the bride doesn't know who her father is. So Sophie sends out invitations to three men who might fit the bill, hoping to solve the riddle once her guests arrive.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Comedy starring Kristen Wiig and Rose Byrne. After Lillian announces her engagement, she asks her lifelong pal Annie to be her maid of honour. However, Annie's life is in a mess, and she finds herself losing control over the bachelorette party to Lillian's seemingly perfect new friend Helen.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs. Four teenage boys pledge to lose their virginity before their high-school prom, but their efforts have hilarious and outrageous consequences.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: One Last Deal
programme.desc: A veteran sports agent scrambles to land one last high-stakes deal for his star client, with both their futures on the line. Drama, starring Danny Dyer and Elliott Rogers

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. programme.title: Hallow Road
programme.desc: Two parents are thrust into a desperate race against time after a late-night call from their daughter reveals she caused a devastating car accident. Director Babak Anvari's psychological thriller, starring Rosamund Pike and Matthew Rhys

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestseller by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Felicity Jones. Renowned symbologist Dr Robert Langdon wakes up in a Florence hospital with a head injury and no memory of the previous 48 hours. However, he soon finds himself hunted and forced to undertake a globe-trotting race against time to prevent the release of a deadly virus capable of killing half the world's population.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller, directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his assistant Dr John Watson think they have seen the back of serial killer Lord Blackwood. But when the evil occultist apparently comes back from the dead, they are once again drawn into a dangerous game.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale
programme.desc: In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal. Romantic drama, starring Joely Richardson, Joanne Froggatt and Paul Giamatti

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

However, after discovering the world of high-stakes poker, she builds her own gambling empire, which makes her rich - and attracts a major federal investigation.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: The 6th Day
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. In a world where the regeneration of pets and the genetic modification of food has become commonplace, helicopter pilot Adam Gibson becomes the victim of an illegal human-cloning operation. Now he must fight to regain his life and find the men responsible.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Benedict Cumberbatch. Captain Kirk's disdain for protocol sees him stripped of the command of the Enterprise, but he is given a chance to prove himself after volunteering to find and stop a mysterious operative who's out to destroy Starfleet.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Sci-fi action thriller starring Colin Farrell and Kate Beckinsale. Factory worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall, a company that implants false memories, in an effort to add a bit of excitement to his life. But while undergoing the procedure he discovers some dark secrets about himself and is soon on the run and fighting to stay alive.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Satirical thriller starring Emma Stone and Jesse Plemons. Conspiracy theorist Teddy and his impressionable cousin Don kidnap biomedical company CEO Michelle and chain her up in the basement of their rural home. Over the next few days, Teddy proceeds to interrogate and torture Michelle in the hope of forcing a simple confession: that she is an emissary from a hostile extraterrestrial race and can take him to her leader.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Amy Adams and Jeremy Renner. After 12 alien spacecraft land in locations around the world, linguistics professor Louise Banks is called in to try to decipher the visitors' language and open a line of communication. Do they come in peace or is humankind on the brink of war?

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: Mystery horror starring Josh Brolin and Julia Garner, with Amy Madigan. A small town is rocked when 17 children from the same school class disappear overnight. Their teacher, Justine, becomes the unofficial prime suspect, with devastated father Archer among those leading the charge against her. But this mass vanishing is only the start of the strange and violent happenings that come to plague the community.

programme.title: Tombstone
programme.desc: Western starring Kurt Russell and Val Kilmer. Arizona 1879: Wyatt Earp arrives in Tombstone to start a business, his career as a lawman behind him. But, with the town in the grip of an organised crime ring, he is soon forced to take up arms.

programme.title: Better Things
programme.desc: Social drama starring Tara Ballard, Liam McIlfatrick and Che Corr. Duane Hopkins' debut feature uses non-actors to tell the stories of a series of young people in a rural Cotswolds community, who escape from the reality of their isolated existence by taking hard drugs.

programme.title: Halls of Montezuma
programme.desc: Second World War action drama starring Richard Widmark. With US forces locked in a battle for supremacy against the Japanese in the South Pacific, a tough marine officer leads a patrol on a dangerous mission to capture enemy soldiers for interrogation.

programme.title: All That Heaven Allows
programme.desc: Melodrama starring Jane Wyman and Rock Hudson. Wealthy widow Cary Scott, after years of shunning company, falls in love with gardener Ron Kirby, who is 15 years her junior. The difference in social status as well as their age shocks her family and friends, and soon their relationship is affected by gossip.

programme.title: Lifeboat
programme.desc: Second World War drama directed by Alfred Hitchcock, starring Tallulah Bankhead and William Bendix. Eight survivors from a torpedoed ship, adrift in a lifeboat, take on board a German U-boat captain whose presence causes escalating tension.

programme.title: Sea Wife
programme.desc: Second World War romantic adventure starring Joan Collins and Richard Burton. After their ship is torpedoed off Singapore, an RAF officer is cast adrift with three other survivors and becomes attracted to the only woman among them.

programme.title: Wild Horse Nine Interview Special
programme.desc: Writer/director Martin McDonagh and cast discuss the Film4-produced political comedy thriller Wild Horse Nine.

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Bill Paxton, Helen Hunt and Cary Elwes. When one of the planet's most deadly natural phenomena blows into town, a feuding team of professional tornado-chasing meteorologists tracks the trail of destruction.

programme.title: Commando
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. Special Forces Colonel John Matrix retires to his mountain home and steadfastly refuses to return to active service. But when his daughter is kidnapped by South American revolutionaries, Matrix must undertake his most important mission - to rescue her.

programme.title: X.
programme.desc: Horror starring Mia Goth, Jenna Ortega and Brittany Snow. The cast and crew of an adult film show up at the remote farm that they have booked for their shoot. But something weird is going on with the farm's elderly owners, and bodies soon start to pile up...

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: A logging company owner and his family find themselves in a dangerous situation when they uncover a drug trafficker's hidden stash of cocaine in their cabin. Action thriller, starring Jason Momoa, Garret Dillahunt and Jill Wagner

programme.title: Age of Kill
programme.desc: A professional sniper is blackmailed into taking a new mission, which involves shooting six people in six hours. If he misses, reports the plot or is caught by the authorities, the terrorist behind the scheme promises to raise the death toll higher. Action thriller, starring Martin Kemp, Patrick Bergin and Bruce Payne

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny are at Love Monster's house, excitedly preparing for Fluffytown's Movie Night. Love Monster has made a huge bag of popcorn to share and is also bringing the new Hero Bunzino movie for everyone to watch. Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and her cousin Eager Beaver have even dressed up as Hero Bunzino for the occasion! They head out, but when Love Monster tries to carry the huge bag of popcorn out, it gets stuck in his doorway. He gives it a big push, which causes some popcorn to spill out and cover Eager Beaver, who captures the whole thing on her new movie camera.
In his panic to clean the popcorn up, Love Monster accidentally tosses the movie back inside his house and doesn't realise. Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny worries that they might be late for Movie Night, but Love Monster says he knows a short cut. The friends set off and walk through Fluffytown Forest, but they don't get far before Love Monster almost falls into a wide ditch, dangling over the edge. Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and Eager Beaver help him out and wonder how they are going to get across the ditch. Love Monster looks around and spots some overhanging vines. They can swing across! Love Monster leads the way as he, rather ungracefully, manages to swing himself and the others across the ditch.
Love Monster leads them as they continue on their journey to Movie Night, struggling with the popcorn but overcoming a series of obstacles until they come to a high cliff. How are they going to get the popcorn up the cliff? Love Monster wishes that Hero Bunzino was there as she would know what to do. He looks around and sees a branch overhanging the cliff and has another idea. He's not sure if he's heroic enough to pull it off, but he's going to try. Love Monster throws the rope of the popcorn bag up and over the branch and then grabs it to pull the bag up.
The bag of popcorn catches on the branch at the top, and the friends are able to use it to climb up. They reach the top, but when they try to move on, they realise that the bag is still stuck on the branch. They tug on the other end of it with all their might and it bursts open, showering them with popcorn and sending them rolling down a hill. The trio pop their heads out of the mound of popcorn to see that they've made it to the Movie Night outdoor cinema! Everyone is pleased to see them (and the popcorn), but when Elder Kitten says that it's time for the movie, Love Monster realises that he doesn't have it. He left it at home!
Everybody is disappointed as they think they can no longer have Movie Night, but just then Eager Beaver holds up her camera... maybe they can. Eager Beaver plugs her camera in and everyone marvels as videos of Love Monster's heroics project onto the big screen. Just like Hero Bunzino!

programme.title: The Goldbergs

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Claire struggles to find the right moment to sack an employee, while Phil catches Luke in a compromising position at home and everyone fails to notice that Alex has moved back for the summer. programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: All three families trying to cope with their separate holiday experiences, before everyone tries to make their way back home in time for Father's Day. programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay does not want to give the new family moving in across the street the wrong impression and goes out of his way to make sure they know he is the best kind of neighbor, while Manny decides that the best way to an attractive and radical-thinking teenage girl's heart is through his actions. Meanwhile, at the Pritchett house, the entire family is using Alex's recent bout of mono to their advantage. Finally, Cam and Mitchell have always felt they were the most open, non-judgmental and supportive parents. However, when they overhear Lily insulting her new friend, they have to take a quick look in the mirror before they teach her a lesson about acceptance.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Dunphys and Pritchetts go head-to-head when Luke decides his best chance at getting into college is to run for senior class president against Manny. programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Principal Skinner introduces a unique incentive to stop pupils being naughty - a ride on a submarine. But has the youngster committed too many crimes against Skinner to wipe the slate clean? Meanwhile, Lisa helps Krusty with his money troubles

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
