programme.desc: Bart falls in love with the daughter of film star Rainier Wolfcastle, but their romance falters and she ends up going out with Milhouse in a bid to make him jealous. With the voices of Reese Witherspoon and chef Wolfgang Puck

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Fleeing a dog that hates him for no reason, Bart meets a faded Western star. With Marge's help, Bart tries to get him off booze and start him on a better life.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer revitalizes Bumblebee Man's career when he becomes his secret stuntman. But how much punishment can a Stunt-Bee take before it starts to sting?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The family visits Brazil to find a missing orphan Lisa has been sponsoring, leaving Maggie under the watchful eyes of Patty and Selma - but it is not long before Homer is kidnapped and held to ransom by bandits

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: As Adam celebrates his 16th birthday, his parents are too distracted by Barry and Lainey's engagement and Erica's band ambitions to acknowledge their youngest son's big day. However, the situation presents an opportunity for Adam to ask Erica to put him on the high school social map. Meanwhile, Beverly thinks she can scare Barry and Lainey straight with the reality of being adults

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam's girlfriend Jackie returns after spending the summer in New York and seems like a different person. After receiving some bad advice from his loved ones, Adam takes drastic measures to hold on to his relationship. Beverly is not happy with Lainey's domestic skills and decides to teach her future daughter-in-law a thing or two about family catering

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Claire struggles to find the right moment to sack an employee, while Phil catches Luke in a compromising position at home and everyone fails to notice that Alex has moved back for the summer. Elsewhere, Jay refuses to accept that finding a job again might be harder than he thought and Lily gets caught in the middle when Cameron and Mitch decide to spend the summer apart

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: All three families trying to cope with their separate holiday experiences, before everyone tries to make their way back home in time for Father's Day. The Dunphys are wrapping up their trip to New York City, while Cam and Mitchell are caring for Cam's dying grandmother in Missouri, and Jay, Gloria and Manny are attending a wedding in Mexico - but all of their respective trips are thrown into turmoil

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay does not want to give the new family moving in across the street the wrong impression and goes out of his way to make sure they know he is the best kind of neighbor, while Manny decides that the best way to an attractive and radical-thinking teenage girl's heart is through his actions. Meanwhile, at the Pritchett house, the entire family is using Alex's recent bout of mono to their advantage. Finally, Cam and Mitchell have always felt they were the most open, non-judgmental and supportive parents. However, when they overhear Lily insulting her new friend, they have to take a quick look in the mirror before they teach her a lesson about acceptance.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Dunphys and Pritchetts go head-to-head when Luke decides his best chance at getting into college is to run for senior class president against Manny. Phil insists on introducing Haley to marketing guru Merv Schechter (guest star Martin Short), while Cam makes a rash decision when he finds out his star football player is moving away

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Principal Skinner introduces a unique incentive to stop pupils being naughty - a ride on a submarine. It seems to do the trick, and before long Springfield Elementary's finest are competing to be the best behaved - including Bart. But has the youngster committed too many crimes against Skinner to wipe the slate clean? Meanwhile, Lisa helps Krusty with his money troubles

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A radiation leak at the nuclear plant causes snow to fall, just in time for Christmas - and when Springfield is inundated with festive holiday-makers, Marge sees a chance to make some extra cash by opening up the family home to boarders. Meanwhile, Lisa decides it's the thought that counts when buying this year's gifts - much to the annoyance of Bart

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer is fed up with the price of movies, so he starts illegally downloading films and opens his own cinema in the back yard. However, when Marge turns him in, he gets busted by a government anti-piracy squad, and finds himself in trouble with a host of Hollywood bigwigs, including writer and director Judd Apatow and actors Leslie Mann, Paul Rudd, Will Arnett and Channing Tatum

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Comic Book Guy hasn't had much luck with the ladies in the past but all that changes when he takes advice from Marvel Comics head honcho Stan Lee, who gives him the courage to ask out a Japanese manga artist - and what woman wouldn't be wowed by a bouquet of flowers delivered in a Hulk hand?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer and Bart perform street magic in a bid to impress passers-by and raise enough cash to pay a mechanic's bill. Unfortunately, they quickly realise people are suckers for a sob story, and start conning the public for money. Featuring the guest voice of Edward Norton

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Ava Fest is back, and with the help of the teachers, Ava's determined to outdo last year by any means necessary. And after Janine accepts the offer of a full-time position at the district, she just has to check off one last thing to make it official

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Vivian is terrified of turning 40, and chooses to mark the occasion by taking up dancing in a bid to achieve her lifelong dream of becoming a professional performer

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will strikes up a friendship with an overweight girl but is reluctant to take her out in public, fearing he will be teased. Queen Latifah guest stars

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics sit down to watch Squid Game: The Challenge - the real-life version of the Netflix hit - and get hot under the collar with Channel 4's swinging drama The Couple Next Door. Plus, The Toy Hospital, Survivor, Vinnie Jones in the Country, Tony Robinson's Marvellous Machines and Lorraine. From December 2023

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including Squid Game: The Challenge, The Couple Next Door, Strictly Come Dancing, The Graham Norton Show, Planet Earth III, Matt Baker: Travels with Mum & Dad and Jingle All the Way. From December 2023

programme.title: Wrath of Man
programme.desc: Action thriller directed by Guy Ritchie and starring Jason Statham. A new employee working as a security guard for an armoured truck company proves his mettle during an attempted heist. His colleagues are impressed, and then increasingly suspicious about his skill set and motivation.

programme.title: Tombstone
programme.desc: Western starring Kurt Russell and Val Kilmer. Arizona 1879: Wyatt Earp arrives in Tombstone to start a business, his career as a lawman behind him. But, with the town in the grip of an organised crime ring, he is soon forced to take up arms.

programme.title: Better Things
programme.desc: Social drama starring Tara Ballard, Liam McIlfatrick and Che Corr. Duane Hopkins' debut feature uses non-actors to tell the stories of a series of young people in a rural Cotswolds community, who escape from the reality of their isolated existence by taking hard drugs.

programme.title: Halls of Montezuma
programme.desc: Second World War action drama starring Richard Widmark. With US forces locked in a battle for supremacy against the Japanese in the South Pacific, a tough marine officer leads a patrol on a dangerous mission to capture enemy soldiers for interrogation.

programme.title: All That Heaven Allows
programme.desc: Melodrama starring Jane Wyman and Rock Hudson. Wealthy widow Cary Scott, after years of shunning company, falls in love with gardener Ron Kirby, who is 15 years her junior. The difference in social status as well as their age shocks her family and friends, and soon their relationship is affected by gossip.

programme.title: Lifeboat
programme.desc: Second World War drama directed by Alfred Hitchcock, starring Tallulah Bankhead and William Bendix. Eight survivors from a torpedoed ship, adrift in a lifeboat, take on board a German U-boat captain whose presence causes escalating tension.

programme.title: Sea Wife
programme.desc: Second World War romantic adventure starring Joan Collins and Richard Burton. After their ship is torpedoed off Singapore, an RAF officer is cast adrift with three other survivors and becomes attracted to the only woman among them.

Meanwhile, babirusa Betty is introduced to bachelor Mentari, with the hope that the plucky pigs hit it off and give the Park its first-ever babirusa piglet. At The Seas with Nemo & Friends at EPCOT, an 1,800-pound rescued manatee, Lou, has a potentially infected tail, so keepers must use a crane to lift him out of the aquarium to transport him for a high-def CT scan.

programme.title: Magic of Disney's Animal Kingdom
programme.desc: Meet the mandrills of the Harambe Wildlife Reserve! This lively bunch has been bickering lately, so animal manager Beth and keepers Erin and Kerri decide to bring in a distraction. They introduce Linus, a hunky new monkey who manages to charm the all-female squad. On the other side of the reserve, animal keeper Nicole has a soft spot for Scooter and Zawadi, a stinky hyena pair with a spotty reputation. She helps them clean up with a spa day that includes tasty treats, a back scratch, and a relaxing bubble bath. Over at Maharajah Jungle Trek, animal keeper Susan helps Sohni, an eight-year-old Sumatran tiger, face a tough challenge - undergoing a voluntary blood test. Cassanova, an Abyssinian ground hornbill and a fan-favorite resident of Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge & Villas, receives a new diet and a feather makeover to strut his stuff again. Later, engineers must perform an overnight operation to inspect an underwater fence within the black rhino habitat.

With a possible murder on their doorstep, Thames Valley Major Crime Unit launch Operation Inuit and begin an intense investigation that unravels a love triangle and a killing motivated by twisted passion and male pride.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick meets a family who make some of the best Gouda cheese in Britain, and uses their creations to make a tortilla dish with caramelised apples and onions. In the fishing village of Mevagissey, he discovers the origins of the sea shanty and the history of the pilchard fishing industry, when shoals of pilchards were so large they would attract killer whales

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick meets chef Tom Adams, who runs Combeshead Farm, a leading field-to-fork restaurant where they grow and produce all of their own food, from sourdough bread to pork pies, as well as rearing a small herd of Mangalitsa pigs, a hairy, old-world breed that produces exquisite hams. Rick tries out a new recipe - pork chops with a sloe berry sauce - before moving on to the village of Rock, where his son Jack holds a clam bake on the shore of the Camel Estuary

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: The town of Launceston in east Cornwall is bypassed by many who visit the county, yet Rick discovers that it's home to an unusual superstition and a rare type of Norman castle. programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches London on his rail journey from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In Ealing, he is transformed for the silver screen by expert hair and make-up, before travelling to Fulham, where he heads underground to explore London's new super sewer. Then, Michael visits the London School of Economics and Political Science in central London, before finally arriving in Kensington

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo journeys from Piccadilly Circus to Gravesend, visiting an exotic West End store that was popular among Victorian women and hearing how a Russian ballet company took London by storm in 1909. He also discovers the origins of netball and gymslips at North Kent College and meets the pilots of the Port of London Authority, founded in the early 20th century

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In the orchards of East Malling, Kent, Michael discovers how the Edwardians' serious attitude towards cultivation bears fruit even now. In Folkestone, he hears how the town coped with an influx of more than 100,000 refugees fleeing the German invasion in 1914. In the High Weald, Michael heads for Tenterden Town and the light railway that opened in 1900. His final stop is the medieval Cinque Port of Rye, where he tours the home and garden of author Henry James

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the Britain of the 1930s as he sets out on another adventure. Beginning just outside Newcastle in Jarrow, Michael uncovers the desperation that led 200 men to march 300 miles to Westminster in order to petition the government for work. The first leg of his journey ends Spennymoor, Co Durham, where he meets the son of a miner who became one of the most famous 20th-century artists of the region

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in Northumbria en route to the Highlands, heading to Kielder Forest to discover what lay behind a national initiative to plant one of the largest manmade woodlands in Europe. Crossing the border to Scotland, Michael arrives in the weaving town of Hawick to visit Lovat Mill, where, in the 1930s, tweed was big business, and also goes to the movies, sitting in the front stalls at the Dominion cinema in Morningside

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Following the route of the old Caledonian Railway Company, Michael Portillo discovers the 'Riviera of the Highlands'. With a daily direct train service to Kings Cross, Gleneagles remains a top destination and is also headquarters for the British School of Falconry. Berry Town, aka Blairgowrie, is Michael's next stop. At the home of the Scottish raspberry industry, which once sent fruit to London daily on board a raspberry special service from Cooper Angus station, Michael learns how to pick this most delicate of berries. The last stop on this leg is the city of Dundee, where he visits publisher DC Thomson

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores how British rule led to armed rebellion in America, and a loyalty in Canada that lasted until the very end of the Empire. On Long Island, Michael visits The Brewster House, a former tavern where British soldiers met and talked freely during the Revolutionary War, unaware that it was run by George Washington's Culper Spy Ring. He also calls in at Fort Niagara, where he learns how the native peoples of North America saw their tribes and families torn apart as they picked sides, shedding blood on behalf of either the crown or the patriots

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero
programme.desc: Part one of two. The comedian heads to Indonesia to follow in the footsteps of Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace, who devised the theory of evolution through natural selection independently of Charles Darwin. Bill encounters orang-utans, flying frogs and extraordinary bugs on a mission to understand how Wallace came up with his idea, and tries to win him the recognition he deserves

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero
programme.desc: Part two of two. The comedian continues his journey retracing the footsteps of Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace by heading to Indonesian archipelago the Moluccas, formerly known by the nickname of the Spice Islands. There Bill encounters boggle-eyed tarsiers, monkeys with Mohican hairstyles and spectacular birds of paradise on his mission to understand how Wallace devised the theory of evolution independently of Charles Darwin

In Folkestone, he hears how the town coped with an influx of more than 100,000 refugees fleeing the German invasion in 1914. In the High Weald, Michael heads for Tenterden Town and the light railway that opened in 1900. His final stop is the medieval Cinque Port of Rye, where he tours the home and garden of author Henry James

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the Britain of the 1930s as he sets out on another adventure. Beginning just outside Newcastle in Jarrow, Michael uncovers the desperation that led 200 men to march 300 miles to Westminster in order to petition the government for work. The first leg of his journey ends Spennymoor, Co Durham, where he meets the son of a miner who became one of the most famous 20th-century artists of the region

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in Northumbria en route to the Highlands, heading to Kielder Forest to discover what lay behind a national initiative to plant one of the largest manmade woodlands in Europe. Crossing the border to Scotland, Michael arrives in the weaving town of Hawick to visit Lovat Mill, where, in the 1930s, tweed was big business, and also goes to the movies, sitting in the front stalls at the Dominion cinema in Morningside

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Following the route of the old Caledonian Railway Company, Michael Portillo discovers the 'Riviera of the Highlands'. With a daily direct train service to Kings Cross, Gleneagles remains a top destination and is also headquarters for the British School of Falconry. Berry Town, aka Blairgowrie, is Michael's next stop. At the home of the Scottish raspberry industry, which once sent fruit to London daily on board a raspberry special service from Cooper Angus station, Michael learns how to pick this most delicate of berries. The last stop on this leg is the city of Dundee, where he visits publisher DC Thomson

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches London on his rail journey from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In Ealing, he is transformed for the silver screen by expert hair and make-up, before travelling to Fulham, where he heads underground to explore London's new super sewer. Then, Michael visits the London School of Economics and Political Science in central London, before finally arriving in Kensington

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores how British rule led to armed rebellion in America, and a loyalty in Canada that lasted until the very end of the Empire. On Long Island, Michael visits The Brewster House, a former tavern where British soldiers met and talked freely during the Revolutionary War, unaware that it was run by George Washington's Culper Spy Ring. He also calls in at Fort Niagara, where he learns how the native peoples of North America saw their tribes and families torn apart as they picked sides, shedding blood on behalf of either the crown or the patriots

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero
programme.desc: Part one of two. The comedian heads to Indonesia to follow in the footsteps of Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace, who devised the theory of evolution through natural selection independently of Charles Darwin. Bill encounters orang-utans, flying frogs and extraordinary bugs on a mission to understand how Wallace came up with his idea, and tries to win him the recognition he deserves

programme.title: Women Behind Bars with Trevor McDonald
programme.desc: Part one of two. programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo completes his rail journey through 1930s Britain, beginning in Norfolk at the headquarters of an international horse welfare organisation. In Peterborough, he visits a tidal defence barrier that helped save the city from flooding, while in Lincolnshire crosses the point at which the Mallard broke the speed record for a steam-powered locomotive in 1938. After a spell in the coastal town of Skegness, Michael's journey ends at RAF Coningsby where he sees some iconic Second World War aircraft, before witnessing a dazzling display featuring the RAF's latest combat aircraft

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's railway journey reaches Greater Manchester, where he celebrates new beginnings for the nation in the years after the Second World War. At Trafford General Hospital, he investigates the birth of the National Health Service. A retired physiotherapist recalls her part in the historic event of July 5, 1948. Coronation Star tells Michael about the first episode of the soap, broadcast live in 1960. And at the city's Science and Industry Museum, the presenter encounters a replica of the Baby, which was created in 1948 - the first machine in the world to run a stored program and the forerunner of all modern computers

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys

Picking up the Empire Builder rail service he travels to Winona, where he finds out how, in the 19th century, the US Army Corps of Engineers made the Mississippi navigable and how the river is maintained today
